source.text: וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים אֵ֚ין מִלְחָמָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין אֲרָ֖ם וּבֵ֥ין יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And they remained three years, there was not war between Aram and between Israel.

en.L: And they remained three years; there was no war between Aram and Israel.
en.B: For three years there was no war between Aram and Israel.
en.R: For three years Aram and Israel did not fight each other.

es.L: Y pasaron tres años sin que hubiera guerra entre Aram e Israel.
es.B: Durante tres años no hubo guerra entre Aram e Israel.
es.R: Durante tres años, Aram e Israel no pelearon entre sí.

fr.L: Et ils restèrent trois ans ; il n’y eut pas de guerre entre Aram et Israël.
fr.B: Pendant trois ans, il n’y eut pas de guerre entre Aram et Israël.
fr.R: Pendant trois ans, Aram et Israël ne se sont pas fait la guerre.

sw.L: Wakakaa miaka mitatu; hapakuwa na vita kati ya Aramu na Israeli.
sw.B: Kwa miaka mitatu hapakuwa na vita kati ya Aramu na Israeli.
sw.R: Kwa miaka mitatu Aramu na Israeli hawakupigana.

vi.L: Họ ở yên ba năm; không có chiến tranh giữa A-ram và Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Suốt ba năm, giữa A-ram và Y-sơ-ra-ên không có chiến tranh.
vi.R: Trong ba năm, A-ram và Y-sơ-ra-ên không đánh nhau.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 3년 동안 지냈는데, 아람과 이스라엘 사이에 전쟁이 없었다.
ko.B: 3년 동안 아람과 이스라엘 사이에는 전쟁이 없었다.
ko.R: 3년 동안 아람과 이스라엘은 서로 싸우지 않았다.

pt.L: E ficaram três anos; não houve guerra entre Arã e Israel.
pt.B: Durante três anos não houve guerra entre Arã e Israel.
pt.R: Durante três anos, Arã e Israel não lutaram um contra o outro.

decisions.choice: three years without war: the peace that followed the treaty of 20:34
decisions.reason: Chapter 20 ended with Ahab sparing Ben-hadad king of Aram and making a treaty with him (20:31-34). The three quiet years follow from that treaty; verse 2 dates the new campaign to the third of them.

decisions.choice: Aram: the kingdom of the Arameans, ruled from Damascus
decisions.reason: Aram was the Aramean kingdom north-east of Israel, with Damascus as its capital (20:34). Its king in these chapters is Ben-hadad (20:1).

source.text: וַיְהִ֖י בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑ית וַיֵּ֛רֶד יְהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֖ה אֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was in the year the third, and went down Jehoshaphat king of Judah to [the] king of Israel.

en.L: And it happened in the third year that Jehoshaphat king of Judah went down to the king of Israel.
en.B: Then in the third year Jehoshaphat king of Judah went down to visit Israel's king.
en.R: In the third year, Jehoshaphat king of Judah went to visit the king of Israel.

es.L: Y sucedió en el tercer año que Josafat, rey de Judá, descendió al rey de Israel.
es.B: Luego, en el tercer año, Josafat, rey de Judá, bajó a visitar al rey de Israel.
es.R: En el tercer año, Josafat, rey de Judá, fue a visitar al rey de Israel.

fr.L: Et il arriva, la troisième année, que Josaphat, roi de Juda, descendit vers le roi d’Israël.
fr.B: La troisième année, Josaphat, roi de Juda, descendit rendre visite au roi d’Israël.
fr.R: La troisième année, Josaphat, roi de Juda, est allé rendre visite au roi d’Israël.

sw.L: Ikawa katika mwaka wa tatu, Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda akashuka kwa mfalme wa Israeli.
sw.B: Kisha katika mwaka wa tatu, Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda alishuka kumtembelea mfalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa tatu, Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda alikwenda kumtembelea mfalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Xảy ra vào năm thứ ba, Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa đi xuống thăm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Đến năm thứ ba, Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa đi xuống thăm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Vào năm thứ ba, Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa đi thăm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 셋째 해에 유다 왕 여호사밧이 이스라엘 왕에게 내려갔다.
ko.B: 그러다가 셋째 해에 유다 왕 여호사밧이 이스라엘 왕을 만나러 내려갔다.
ko.R: 셋째 해에 유다 왕 여호사밧이 이스라엘 왕을 찾아갔다.

pt.L: E aconteceu no terceiro ano que Josafá, rei de Judá, desceu ao rei de Israel.
pt.B: Então, no terceiro ano, Josafá, rei de Judá, desceu para visitar o rei de Israel.
pt.R: No terceiro ano, Josafá, rei de Judá, foi visitar o rei de Israel.

decisions.choice: 2 Chronicles 18 retells this story
decisions.reason: The account of the campaign against Ramoth-gilead, from Jehoshaphat's visit to Ahab's death (verses 2-35), is told again in 2 Chronicles 18:2-34, in nearly the same words. Chronicles adds that Jehoshaphat had made a marriage alliance with Ahab (2 Chronicles 18:1; compare 2 Kings 8:18) and that a prophet rebuked him afterward for helping Ahab (2 Chronicles 19:1-3).

decisions.choice: the king of Israel: Ahab
decisions.reason: Through most of this story the narrator calls him only "the king of Israel". He is Ahab (16:29; 20:2), and his name appears in verse 20 and again at his death (verses 39-40). Jehoshaphat son of Asa had become king of Judah when Asa died (15:24).

decisions.choice: went down: traveled from Jerusalem north to Samaria
decisions.reason: Jerusalem stands high in the hill country, so a journey away from it is spoken of as going down. Verse 10 shows the kings meeting at Samaria, Ahab's capital.

decisions.choice: went down to visit / went to visit
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "to visit" to make clear this was a royal visit, not an attack. Readable drops "down" (m3).

decisions.choice: Josafá, rei de Judá
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the king of Judah takes the form Brazilian readers know, "Josafá", as set for Kings, and keeps it through 2 Kings 3.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־עֲבָדָ֔יו הַיְדַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּֽי־לָ֖נוּ רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ מַחְשִׁ֔ים מִקַּ֣חַת אֹתָ֔הּ מִיַּ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אֲרָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said [the] king of Israel to his servants, do you know that to us [belongs] Ramoth-gilead, and we [are] being inactive from taking it from [the] hand of [the] king of Aram?

en.L: And the king of Israel said to his servants, "Do you know that Ramoth-gilead [belongs] to us, and we are keeping still from taking it from the hand of the king of Aram?"
en.B: The king of Israel said to his officials, "You know that Ramoth-gilead belongs to us, yet we are doing nothing to take it back from the king of Aram."
en.R: The king of Israel said to his officials, "You know that the city of Ramoth-gilead belongs to us. But we are doing nothing to take it back from the king of Aram!"

es.L: Y el rey de Israel dijo a sus siervos: «¿{{plural_you:Saben|Sabéis}} que Ramot de Galaad es nuestra, y nosotros estamos quietos sin tomarla de mano del rey de Aram?».
es.B: El rey de Israel dijo a sus oficiales: «{{plural_you:Ustedes saben|Vosotros sabéis}} que Ramot de Galaad nos pertenece, y sin embargo no hacemos nada para recuperarla del rey de Aram».
es.R: El rey de Israel dijo a sus oficiales: «{{plural_you:Ustedes saben|Vosotros sabéis}} que la ciudad de Ramot de Galaad nos pertenece. ¡Pero no estamos haciendo nada para recuperarla del rey de Aram!».

fr.L: Et le roi d’Israël dit à ses serviteurs : « Savez-vous que Ramoth de Galaad [est] à nous, et nous restons tranquilles au lieu de la reprendre de la main du roi d’Aram ? »
fr.B: Le roi d’Israël dit à ses officiers : « Vous savez que Ramoth de Galaad nous appartient, et nous ne faisons rien pour la reprendre au roi d’Aram ! »
fr.R: Le roi d’Israël a dit à ses officiers : « Vous savez que la ville de Ramoth de Galaad est à nous. Mais nous ne faisons rien pour la reprendre au roi d’Aram ! »

sw.L: Mfalme wa Israeli akawaambia watumishi wake, "Je, mnajua kwamba Ramoth-gileadi [ni] mali yetu, nasi tunanyamaza bila kuitwaa kutoka mkononi mwa mfalme wa Aramu?"
sw.B: Mfalme wa Israeli akawaambia maafisa wake, "Mnajua kwamba Ramoth-gileadi ni mali yetu, lakini hatufanyi lolote kuirudisha kutoka kwa mfalme wa Aramu."
sw.R: Mfalme wa Israeli akawaambia maafisa wake, "Mnajua kwamba mji wa Ramoth-gileadi ni mali yetu. Lakini hatufanyi chochote kuuchukua tena kutoka kwa mfalme wa Aramu!"

vi.L: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên nói với các đầy tớ mình: "Các ngươi có biết rằng Ra-mốt Ga-la-át thuộc về chúng ta, mà chúng ta cứ ngồi yên không lấy lại khỏi tay vua A-ram không?"
vi.B: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên nói với các quần thần: "Các ngươi biết Ra-mốt Ga-la-át là của chúng ta, thế mà chúng ta chẳng làm gì để lấy lại thành ấy từ tay vua A-ram."
vi.R: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên nói với các quan chức của mình: "Các ngươi biết thành Ra-mốt Ga-la-át là của chúng ta. Thế mà chúng ta chẳng làm gì để lấy lại thành ấy từ tay vua A-ram!"

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕이 그의 신하들에게 말했다. "너희는 길르앗 라못이 우리 것인데도, 우리가 그것을 아람 왕의 손에서 빼앗지 않고 가만히 있는 것을 알고 있느냐?"
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕이 신하들에게 말했다. "너희도 알다시피 길르앗 라못은 우리 땅인데, 우리는 그것을 아람 왕의 손에서 되찾으려고 아무것도 하지 않고 있다."
ko.R: 이스라엘 왕이 신하들에게 말했다. "너희도 알다시피 길르앗 라못 성은 우리 것이다. 그런데 우리는 그 성을 아람 왕에게서 되찾으려고 아무것도 하지 않고 있다!"

pt.L: E o rei de Israel disse aos seus servos: "Vocês sabem que Ramote-Gileade [é] nossa, e nós estamos parados, sem tomá-la da mão do rei de Arã?"
pt.B: O rei de Israel disse aos seus oficiais: "Vocês sabem que Ramote-Gileade nos pertence, e mesmo assim não fazemos nada para tomá-la de volta do rei de Arã."
pt.R: O rei de Israel disse aos seus oficiais: "Vocês sabem que a cidade de Ramote-Gileade é nossa. Mas não estamos fazendo nada para tomá-la de volta do rei de Arã!"

decisions.choice: Ramoth-gilead: an Israelite town east of the Jordan held by Aram
decisions.reason: Ramoth in Gilead lay east of the Jordan, in the territory of Gad. It was one of the cities of refuge (Deuteronomy 4:43; Joshua 20:8) and the seat of one of Solomon's district officers (4:13). In the treaty of 20:34 Ben-hadad promised to return the cities his father had taken from Israel; Ramoth-gilead seems to have stayed in Aram's hands.

decisions.choice: do you know ...?: a question that means "you know"
decisions.reason: The king does not ask for information. He reminds his officials of something they all know, to make his point that it is shameful to do nothing.

decisions.choice: we are keeping still: we are idle, doing nothing
decisions.reason: The verb means to be silent or inactive. The king complains that Israel has made no move to recover the town.

decisions.choice: officials
decisions.reason: The servants of a king are his court officials. Literal keeps "servants"; Balanced and Readable say "officials", as these books do for the king's servants.

decisions.choice: a statement in place of the question
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state as a fact what the Hebrew puts as a question (m2).

decisions.choice: "Ramot de Galaad"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish form of Ramoth-gilead, with Galaad as in the Spanish of Samuel.

decisions.choice: "Ramoth de Galaad"
decisions.reason: The town is Ramoth in Gilead; French writes it as Yabesh de Galaad in Samuel.

decisions.choice: "Ra-mốt Ga-la-át"
decisions.reason: The usual Protestant form of Ramoth-gilead, built on "Ga-la-át" as in Samuel.

decisions.choice: Ramote-Gileade
decisions.reason: As set for the whole book at 4:13: the town is one hyphenated name through this chapter (verses 4, 6, 12, 15, 20, 29).

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט הֲתֵלֵ֥ךְ אִתִּ֛י לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה רָמֹ֣ת גִּלְעָ֑ד וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כָּמ֧וֹנִי כָמ֛וֹךָ כְּעַמִּ֥י כְעַמֶּ֖ךָ כְּסוּסַ֥י כְּסוּסֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to Jehoshaphat, will you go with me to the battle [at] Ramoth-gilead? And said Jehoshaphat to [the] king of Israel, as me as you, as my people as your people, as my horses as your horses.

en.L: And he said to Jehoshaphat, "Will you go with me to battle at Ramoth-gilead?" And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "As I [am], so [are] you; as my people, so your people; as my horses, so your horses."
en.B: He asked Jehoshaphat, "Will you go with me to fight at Ramoth-gilead?" Jehoshaphat answered the king of Israel, "I am as you are, my troops are as your troops, my horses as your horses."
en.R: Then he turned to Jehoshaphat. "Will you join me in attacking Ramoth-gilead?" he asked. Jehoshaphat told the king of Israel, "I am with you all the way. My army and my horses are yours to command."

es.L: Y dijo a Josafat: «¿Irás conmigo a la batalla [en] Ramot de Galaad?». Y Josafat dijo al rey de Israel: «Como yo, así tú; como mi pueblo, así tu pueblo; como mis caballos, así tus caballos».
es.B: Le preguntó a Josafat: «¿Vendrás conmigo a pelear en Ramot de Galaad?». Josafat le respondió al rey de Israel: «Yo soy como tú, mis tropas son como tus tropas, y mis caballos como tus caballos».
es.R: Luego se volvió hacia Josafat. «¿Me acompañarás a atacar Ramot de Galaad?», le preguntó. Josafat le dijo al rey de Israel: «Estoy contigo en todo. Mi ejército y mis caballos están a tus órdenes».

fr.L: Et il dit à Josaphat : « Viendras-tu avec moi au combat [à] Ramoth de Galaad ? » Et Josaphat dit au roi d’Israël : « Moi comme toi, mon peuple comme ton peuple, mes chevaux comme tes chevaux. »
fr.B: Il demanda à Josaphat : « Viendras-tu avec moi combattre à Ramoth de Galaad ? » Josaphat répondit au roi d’Israël : « Je suis comme toi, mes troupes sont comme tes troupes, mes chevaux comme tes chevaux. »
fr.R: Ensuite il s’est tourné vers Josaphat : « Veux-tu venir avec moi attaquer Ramoth de Galaad ? » lui a-t-il demandé. Josaphat a dit au roi d’Israël : « Je suis entièrement avec toi. Mon armée et mes chevaux sont à tes ordres. »

sw.L: Akamwambia Yehoshafati, "Je, utakwenda pamoja nami vitani [huko] Ramoth-gileadi?" Yehoshafati akamwambia mfalme wa Israeli, "Kama mimi [nilivyo], ndivyo ulivyo wewe; kama watu wangu, ndivyo watu wako; kama farasi wangu, ndivyo farasi wako."
sw.B: Akamwuliza Yehoshafati, "Je, utakwenda pamoja nami kupigana huko Ramoth-gileadi?" Yehoshafati akamjibu mfalme wa Israeli, "Mimi ni kama wewe, askari wangu ni kama askari wako, farasi wangu ni kama farasi wako."
sw.R: Kisha akamgeukia Yehoshafati, akamwuliza, "Je, utaungana nami kuushambulia Ramoth-gileadi?" Yehoshafati akamwambia mfalme wa Israeli, "Niko pamoja nawe kabisa. Jeshi langu na farasi wangu wako chini ya amri yako."

vi.L: Vua nói với Giô-sa-phát: "Vua có đi với tôi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không?" Giô-sa-phát nói với vua Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Tôi cũng như vua, dân tôi như dân vua, ngựa tôi như ngựa vua."
vi.B: Vua hỏi Giô-sa-phát: "Vua có đi với tôi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không?" Giô-sa-phát đáp với vua Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Tôi cũng như vua, quân tôi như quân vua, ngựa tôi như ngựa vua."
vi.R: Rồi vua quay sang hỏi Giô-sa-phát: "Vua có cùng tôi tấn công Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không?" Giô-sa-phát trả lời vua Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Tôi sẵn sàng đi với vua. Quân đội và ngựa của tôi đều nghe theo lệnh vua."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 여호사밧에게 말했다. "나와 함께 길르앗 라못으로 싸우러 가겠소?" 그러자 여호사밧이 이스라엘 왕에게 말했다. "나는 당신과 같고, 내 백성은 당신의 백성과 같고, 내 말들은 당신의 말들과 같소."
ko.B: 그가 여호사밧에게 물었다. "나와 함께 길르앗 라못으로 싸우러 가겠소?" 여호사밧이 이스라엘 왕에게 대답했다. "나와 당신은 하나요. 내 군대도 당신의 군대와 같고, 내 말들도 당신의 말들과 같소."
ko.R: 그리고 그는 여호사밧에게 물었다. "나와 함께 길르앗 라못을 치러 가겠소?" 여호사밧이 이스라엘 왕에게 대답했다. "나는 끝까지 당신과 함께하겠소. 내 군대와 내 말들도 당신이 마음대로 쓰시오."

pt.L: E ele disse a Josafá: "Você irá comigo à batalha [em] Ramote-Gileade?" E Josafá disse ao rei de Israel: "Como eu, [assim é] você; como o meu povo, o seu povo; como os meus cavalos, os seus cavalos."
pt.B: Ele perguntou a Josafá: "Você irá comigo lutar em Ramote-Gileade?" Josafá respondeu ao rei de Israel: "Eu sou como você, as minhas tropas são como as suas tropas, os meus cavalos como os seus cavalos."
pt.R: Então ele se virou para Josafá e perguntou: "Você vai comigo atacar Ramote-Gileade?" Josafá respondeu ao rei de Israel: "Estou com você para o que der e vier. O meu exército e os meus cavalos estão às suas ordens."

decisions.choice: as I am, so are you ...: I am fully with you; all I have is at your disposal
decisions.reason: Jehoshaphat answers with a set saying of alliance. He puts himself, his army and his chariot horses on the same footing as Ahab's, promising to fight alongside him as one force.

decisions.choice: my people as your people: my army as your army
decisions.reason: Here "people" means the fighting men a king leads into battle, as often in these books.

decisions.choice: horses: the horses of the chariot forces
decisions.reason: Horses in Israel and Judah were used above all to draw war chariots (10:26-29). Promising his horses means promising his chariots.

decisions.choice: troops / army
decisions.reason: The army sense of "people" (m2): Literal keeps "people", Balanced says "troops" and Readable "army", as in these books generally.

decisions.choice: I am with you all the way. My army and my horses are yours to command.
decisions.reason: Readable says what the saying means (m1) rather than repeating its pattern three times.

decisions.choice: the two kings to each other: "tôi" and "vua"
decisions.reason: Two kings speak as equal allies, each calling the other "vua"; "Giô-sa-phát" as the terms note.

decisions.choice: the two kings speak to each other in 하오체
decisions.reason: Allied kings speak as equals, as Asa and Ben-hadad do in 15:19 and Ahab and Ben-hadad in 20:34. Ahab speaks 해라체 to his own officials (verse 3).

decisions.choice: você (the two kings to each other)
decisions.reason: The two kings speak to each other as equals and allies, with "você"; when Jehoshaphat corrects Ahab in verse 8 he turns to the courtly third person, "o rei", as the Hebrew does (m3 there). Readable says what the saying of alliance means (m1) with the Portuguese idiom "para o que der e vier", for whatever may come.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל דְּרָשׁ־נָ֥א כַיּ֖וֹם אֶת־דְּבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Jehoshaphat to [the] king of Israel, seek please as the day the word of Yahweh.

en.L: And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "Please inquire today for the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: But Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "First, please seek the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, "First, please ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says."

es.L: Y Josafat dijo al rey de Israel: «Consulta hoy, por favor, la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.B: Pero Josafat le dijo al rey de Israel: «Primero, por favor, consulta la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.R: Pero Josafat también le dijo al rey de Israel: «Primero, por favor, pregúntale {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} qué dice {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».

fr.L: Et Josaphat dit au roi d’Israël : « Consulte donc aujourd’hui la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Mais Josaphat dit au roi d’Israël : « Consulte d’abord, je te prie, la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Mais Josaphat a aussi dit au roi d’Israël : « S’il te plaît, demande d’abord {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en dit. »

sw.L: Yehoshafati akamwambia mfalme wa Israeli, "Tafadhali, uliulize leo neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Lakini Yehoshafati akamwambia mfalme wa Israeli, "Kwanza, tafadhali, ulitafute neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Lakini Yehoshafati akamwambia pia mfalme wa Israeli, "Kwanza, tafadhali, mwulize {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema nini."

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát nói với vua Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Xin hôm nay hãy cầu hỏi lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.B: Nhưng Giô-sa-phát nói với vua Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Trước hết, xin vua cầu hỏi lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.R: Nhưng Giô-sa-phát cũng nói với vua Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Trước hết, xin vua hỏi xem {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế nào."

ko.L: 그리고 여호사밧이 이스라엘 왕에게 말했다. "부디 오늘 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 구하시오."
ko.B: 그러나 여호사밧이 이스라엘 왕에게 말했다. "먼저 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 여쭈어 보시오."
ko.R: 그러나 여호사밧이 이스라엘 왕에게 또 말했다. "먼저 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 무엇이라고 말씀하시는지 여쭈어 보시오."

pt.L: E Josafá disse ao rei de Israel: "Consulte hoje, por favor, a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}."
pt.B: Mas Josafá disse ao rei de Israel: "Primeiro, por favor, consulte a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}."
pt.R: Mas Josafá também disse ao rei de Israel: "Primeiro, por favor, pergunte {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz."

decisions.choice: seek the word of Yahweh: ask a prophet for Yahweh's answer before going to war
decisions.reason: Kings asked God before a battle whether to go and whether they would win, usually through a prophet or a priest (1 Samuel 23:2-4; 30:7-8). Jehoshaphat will not set out until this has been done.

decisions.choice: as the day: first, now, before anything else
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean "today" or "at once". Here it asks that the inquiry be made now, before they march.

decisions.choice: First
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "first" for the sense of m2; Literal keeps "today".

decisions.choice: "consulta la palabra del SEÑOR"
decisions.reason: "Consultar" as the Samuel note sets for inquiring of the LORD.

decisions.choice: Jehoshaphat and Ahab say "tu" to each other
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: one person is "tu" at every level, kings included.

decisions.choice: "cầu hỏi" for inquiring of the LORD
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's term.

decisions.choice: "주의 말씀을 구하다" (L), "여쭈다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note uses "주께 여쭈다" for inquiring of the LORD; the honorific verb keeps the respect owed to God.

source.text: וַיִּקְבֹּ֨ץ מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אֶֽת־הַנְּבִיאִים֮ כְּאַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֣וֹת אִישׁ֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם הַאֵלֵ֞ךְ עַל־רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אִם־אֶחְדָּ֑ל וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ עֲלֵ֔ה וְיִתֵּ֥ן אֲדֹנָ֖י בְּיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And gathered [the] king of Israel the prophets, about four hundred man, and said to them, shall I go against Ramoth-gilead for battle, or shall I refrain? And they said, go up, and will give the Lord into [the] hand of the king.

en.L: And the king of Israel gathered the prophets, about four hundred men, and said to them, "Shall I go against Ramoth-gilead for battle, or shall I refrain?" And they said, "Go up, and the Lord will give [it] into the hand of the king."
en.B: So the king of Israel gathered the prophets, about four hundred men, and asked them, "Shall I go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or shall I hold back?" "Go up," they said, "for the Lord will give it into the king's hand."
en.R: So the king of Israel called together about four hundred prophets. He asked them, "Should I go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or not?" They answered, "Go! The Lord will help you capture it, Your Majesty."

es.L: Y el rey de Israel reunió a los profetas, como cuatrocientos hombres, y les dijo: «¿Iré contra Ramot de Galaad a la batalla, o desistiré?». Y ellos dijeron: «Sube, porque el Señor [la] entregará en mano del rey».
es.B: Así que el rey de Israel reunió a los profetas, unos cuatrocientos hombres, y les preguntó: «¿Debo ir a la guerra contra Ramot de Galaad, o debo desistir?». «Sube», le dijeron, «porque el Señor la entregará en manos del rey».
es.R: Así que el rey de Israel reunió a unos cuatrocientos profetas. Les preguntó: «¿Debo ir a la guerra contra Ramot de Galaad, o no?». Ellos respondieron: «¡Ve! El Señor te ayudará a conquistarla, oh rey».

fr.L: Et le roi d’Israël rassembla les prophètes, environ quatre cents hommes, et leur dit : « Irai-je contre Ramoth de Galaad pour combattre, ou m’en abstiendrai-je ? » Et ils dirent : « Monte, et le Seigneur [la] livrera entre les mains du roi. »
fr.B: Le roi d’Israël rassembla donc les prophètes, environ quatre cents hommes, et leur demanda : « Dois-je partir en guerre contre Ramoth de Galaad, ou dois-je y renoncer ? » « Monte, dirent-ils, car le Seigneur la livrera entre les mains du roi. »
fr.R: Le roi d’Israël a donc réuni environ quatre cents prophètes. Il leur a demandé : « Est-ce que je dois partir en guerre contre Ramoth de Galaad, ou pas ? » Ils ont répondu : « Vas-y ! Le Seigneur t’aidera à la prendre, ô roi. »

sw.L: Mfalme wa Israeli akawakusanya manabii, kama watu mia nne, akawaambia, "Je, niende kupigana na Ramoth-gileadi, au niache?" Wakasema, "Panda, kwa maana Bwana [ataitia] mkononi mwa mfalme."
sw.B: Basi mfalme wa Israeli akawakusanya manabii, kama watu mia nne, akawauliza, "Je, niende vitani kupigana na Ramoth-gileadi, au nijizuie?" Wakajibu, "Panda, kwa maana Bwana ataitia mkononi mwa mfalme."
sw.R: Basi mfalme wa Israeli akawaita pamoja manabii kama mia nne. Akawauliza, "Je, niende vitani kupigana na Ramoth-gileadi, au nisiende?" Wakajibu, "Nenda! Bwana atakusaidia kuuteka, Mtukufu mfalme."

vi.L: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tập họp các nhà tiên tri, khoảng bốn trăm người, và hỏi họ: "Ta có nên đi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không, hay ta nên thôi?" Họ đáp: "Xin vua đi lên, vì Chúa sẽ phó [thành ấy] vào tay vua."
vi.B: Vậy vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tập họp các nhà tiên tri, khoảng bốn trăm người, và hỏi: "Ta có nên đi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không, hay ta nên dừng lại?" Họ đáp: "Xin vua cứ đi lên, vì Chúa sẽ phó thành ấy vào tay vua."
vi.R: Vậy vua Y-sơ-ra-ên gọi khoảng bốn trăm nhà tiên tri đến. Vua hỏi họ: "Ta có nên đi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át hay không?" Họ trả lời: "Thưa đức vua, xin cứ đi! Chúa sẽ giúp đức vua chiếm được thành ấy."

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕이 예언자들을 400명쯤 모으고 그들에게 말했다. "내가 길르앗 라못을 치러 싸우러 가야 하겠느냐, 그만두어야 하겠느냐?" 그러자 그들이 말했다. "올라가십시오. 주님께서 [그것을] 임금님의 손에 넘겨주실 것입니다."
ko.B: 그래서 이스라엘 왕은 예언자 400명쯤을 모아 놓고 그들에게 물었다. "내가 길르앗 라못을 치러 가야 하겠느냐, 그만두어야 하겠느냐?" 그들이 대답했다. "올라가십시오. 주님께서 그 성을 임금님의 손에 넘겨주실 것입니다."
ko.R: 그래서 이스라엘 왕은 예언자 400명쯤을 불러 모았다. 그가 그들에게 물었다. "내가 길르앗 라못을 치러 가야 하겠느냐, 말아야 하겠느냐?" 그들이 대답했다. "가십시오! 주님께서 임금님이 그 성을 차지하도록 도와주실 것입니다."

pt.L: E o rei de Israel reuniu os profetas, cerca de quatrocentos homens, e lhes disse: "Irei contra Ramote-Gileade para a batalha, ou desistirei?" E eles disseram: "Suba, e o Senhor [a] entregará na mão do rei."
pt.B: Então o rei de Israel reuniu os profetas, cerca de quatrocentos homens, e lhes perguntou: "Devo ir à guerra contra Ramote-Gileade, ou devo desistir?" "Suba", disseram eles, "porque o Senhor a entregará nas mãos do rei."
pt.R: Então o rei de Israel reuniu cerca de quatrocentos profetas. Ele lhes perguntou: "Devo ir à guerra contra Ramote-Gileade, ou não?" Eles responderam: "Vá! O Senhor vai lhe dar a vitória sobre a cidade, Majestade."

decisions.choice: the prophets: a large group of court prophets
decisions.reason: These four hundred are prophets attached to Ahab's court. They speak in the name of Yahweh (verses 11-12, 24), unlike the prophets of Baal and Asherah of 18:19, but Jehoshaphat is not satisfied with them (verse 7).

decisions.choice: the Lord: the title "Lord", not the divine name
decisions.reason: In this first answer the prophets say "the Lord" (Adonai), a title, rather than the name Yahweh. In verses 11-12 they use the name. Whether the title here is a sign of vagueness is not clear.

decisions.choice: will give into the hand of the king: an answer that does not name what is given
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no object: "will give into the hand of the king". The natural sense is that the city will be given to Ahab. The answer is also loose enough to be fulfilled in another way, since it does not say which king or what will be given; verse 15 repeats it, and verses 19-23 show the promise was a deception.

decisions.choice: give into the hand of: give victory over, let capture
decisions.reason: To give something into someone's hand is to put it in their power.

decisions.choice: it
decisions.reason: Balanced supplies "it", the city, as the natural object (m3). Literal brackets the word.

decisions.choice: help you capture it, Your Majesty
decisions.reason: Readable says what "give into the hand" means (m4) and turns "the king" into a direct address, since the prophets are speaking to him.

decisions.choice: "el Señor"
decisions.reason: The prophets use the title *Adonai*, not the divine name, so Spanish writes "el Señor" without the divine_name span, as the Pentateuch note sets.

decisions.choice: "oh rey" (R)
decisions.reason: Where the English Readable says "Your Majesty", Spanish says "oh rey", as the Samuel note sets, since "Majestad" would need "usted".

decisions.choice: "le Seigneur" (no divine_name span)
decisions.reason: The prophets say Adonai, the title, not the name (m2); French writes "Seigneur" in ordinary type, as the Pentateuch note sets it.

decisions.choice: "ô roi" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: the English Readable "Your Majesty" is "ô roi", since "Majesté" would need "vous".

decisions.choice: Bwana
decisions.reason: The court prophets say *Adonai*, the title "Lord", not the divine name, so Swahili writes "Bwana" without capitals and without the span, as the Pentateuch note sets.

decisions.choice: Mtukufu mfalme
decisions.reason: The English Readable "Your Majesty" is "Mtukufu mfalme", as the Swahili of Samuel settled it.

decisions.choice: "Chúa" without capitals for the title "the Lord"
decisions.reason: The court prophets use the title *Adonai*, not the divine name, so the style guide's "Chúa" is used, never the divine_name span.

decisions.choice: "주님" for *Adonai*, not the divine name span
decisions.reason: The court prophets say "the Lord", a title, not the name YHWH (meaning decision); Korean "주님" keeps the difference, as the Korean style guide sets for *Adonai*.

decisions.choice: quatrocentos (every level); o Senhor (Adonai)
decisions.reason: The four hundred are counted in words, a round number, as the style sets it. In this first answer the prophets say "o Senhor", the title, not the divine name (m2), so it is written without capitals and without the reader setting; in verses 11-12 they use the name. They speak to the king in the third person, "o rei", and at Readable with "Majestade", as the English says "Your Majesty".

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט הַאֵ֨ין פֹּ֥ה נָבִ֛יא לַיהוָ֖ה ע֑וֹד וְנִדְרְשָׁ֖ה מֵאוֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Jehoshaphat, is there not here a prophet of Yahweh still, and we may inquire of him?

en.L: And Jehoshaphat said, "Is there not here still a prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that we may inquire of him?"
en.B: But Jehoshaphat said, "Is there no other prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} here whom we can ask?"
en.R: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there not another prophet of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} here? We should ask him too."

es.L: Y Josafat dijo: «¿No hay aquí todavía algún profeta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para que le consultemos?».
es.B: Pero Josafat dijo: «¿No hay aquí ningún otro profeta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a quien podamos consultar?».
es.R: Pero Josafat preguntó: «¿No hay aquí otro profeta {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? Deberíamos consultarle a él también».

fr.L: Et Josaphat dit : « N’y a-t-il plus ici de prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, par qui nous puissions consulter ? »
fr.B: Mais Josaphat dit : « N’y a-t-il pas ici un autre prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, que nous pourrions consulter ? »
fr.R: Mais Josaphat a demandé : « N’y a-t-il pas ici un autre prophète {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? Nous devrions le consulter lui aussi. »

sw.L: Yehoshafati akasema, "Je, hapa hakuna tena nabii wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili tumwulize yeye?"
sw.B: Lakini Yehoshafati akasema, "Je, hakuna nabii mwingine wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hapa ambaye tunaweza kumwuliza?"
sw.R: Lakini Yehoshafati akauliza, "Je, hakuna nabii mwingine wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hapa? Tunapaswa kumwuliza yeye pia."

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát nói: "Ở đây không còn nhà tiên tri nào của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để chúng ta cầu hỏi sao?"
vi.B: Nhưng Giô-sa-phát hỏi: "Ở đây không còn nhà tiên tri nào khác của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để chúng ta cầu hỏi sao?"
vi.R: Nhưng Giô-sa-phát hỏi: "Ở đây không có nhà tiên tri nào khác của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sao? Chúng ta cũng nên hỏi người ấy nữa."

ko.L: 그러자 여호사밧이 말했다. "여기에 우리가 물어볼 만한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자가 아직 있지 않소?"
ko.B: 그러나 여호사밧이 말했다. "여기에 우리가 물어볼 수 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자가 또 없소?"
ko.R: 그러나 여호사밧이 물었다. "여기에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 예언자가 또 없소? 그에게도 물어봐야겠소."

pt.L: E Josafá disse: "Não [há] aqui ainda um profeta {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para que o consultemos?"
pt.B: Mas Josafá perguntou: "Não há aqui nenhum outro profeta {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} a quem possamos consultar?"
pt.R: Mas Josafá perguntou: "Não há aqui outro profeta {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Devíamos perguntar a ele também."

decisions.choice: is there not still here a prophet of Yahweh?: is there no other prophet besides these?
decisions.reason: "Still" means "besides" or "in addition". Jehoshaphat does not deny that the four hundred are prophets, but he wants another voice. The question suggests that he does not trust their quick agreement.

decisions.choice: other / another
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable express "still" as "other" (m1).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל׀אֶֽל־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֡ט ע֣וֹד אִישׁ־אֶחָ֡ד לִדְרֹשׁ֩ אֶת־יְהוָ֨ה מֵאֹת֜וֹ וַאֲנִ֣י שְׂנֵאתִ֗יו כִּ֠י לֹֽא־יִתְנַבֵּ֨א עָלַ֥י טוֹב֙ כִּ֣י אִם־רָ֔ע מִיכָ֖יְהוּ בֶּן־יִמְלָ֑ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט אַל־יֹאמַ֥ר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ כֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And said [the] king of Israel to Jehoshaphat, still [there is] one man to inquire of Yahweh from him, and I hate him, for not he prophesies concerning me good but evil, Micaiah son of Imlah. And said Jehoshaphat, not let say the king so.

en.L: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "[There is] still one man by whom to inquire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil: Micaiah son of Imlah." And Jehoshaphat said, "Let not the king say so."
en.B: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, "There is still one man through whom we could inquire of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Micaiah son of Imlah. But I hate him, for his prophecies about me are never good, only bad." Jehoshaphat said, "Let the king not speak like that."
en.R: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, "There is one more man we could ask to find out what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says. But I hate him. He never says anything good about me. He only predicts trouble for me. His name is Micaiah son of Imlah." Jehoshaphat said, "Your Majesty, you should not say that."

es.L: Y el rey de Israel dijo a Josafat: «Todavía [hay] un hombre por medio del cual consultar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, pero yo lo aborrezco, porque no profetiza acerca de mí el bien, sino el mal: Micaías hijo de Imla». Y Josafat dijo: «No diga eso el rey».
es.B: El rey de Israel le respondió a Josafat: «Todavía hay un hombre por medio del cual podríamos consultar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: Micaías hijo de Imla. Pero yo lo aborrezco, porque sus profecías sobre mí nunca son buenas, sino solo malas». Josafat dijo: «No hable así el rey».
es.R: El rey de Israel le respondió a Josafat: «Hay un hombre más a quien podríamos preguntarle lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Pero yo lo aborrezco. Nunca dice nada bueno de mí. Solo me anuncia desgracias. Se llama Micaías hijo de Imla». Josafat dijo: «Oh rey, no deberías decir eso».

fr.L: Et le roi d’Israël dit à Josaphat : « [Il y a] encore un homme par qui consulter {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, mais moi je le hais, car il ne prophétise pas du bien sur moi, mais du mal : Michée fils de Yimla. » Et Josaphat dit : « Que le roi ne parle pas ainsi. »
fr.B: Le roi d’Israël répondit à Josaphat : « Il reste un homme par qui nous pourrions consulter {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Michée, fils de Yimla. Mais je le hais, car il ne prophétise jamais rien de bon pour moi, seulement du mal. » Josaphat dit : « Que le roi ne parle pas ainsi. »
fr.R: Le roi d’Israël a répondu à Josaphat : « Il y a encore un homme que nous pourrions consulter pour savoir ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Mais je le déteste. Il ne dit jamais rien de bon sur moi. Il ne m’annonce que des malheurs. Il s’appelle Michée, fils de Yimla. » Josaphat a dit : « Ô roi, tu ne devrais pas dire cela. »

sw.L: Mfalme wa Israeli akamwambia Yehoshafati, "Bado [yupo] mtu mmoja ambaye kwa yeye tunaweza kumwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, lakini mimi namchukia, kwa maana hanitabirii mema, bali mabaya: Mikaya mwana wa Imla." Yehoshafati akasema, "Mfalme asiseme hivyo."
sw.B: Mfalme wa Israeli akamjibu Yehoshafati, "Bado yupo mtu mmoja ambaye kupitia yeye tungeweza kumwuliza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: Mikaya mwana wa Imla. Lakini mimi namchukia, kwa sababu hanitabirii kamwe mema juu yangu, ila mabaya tu." Yehoshafati akasema, "Mfalme asiseme hivyo."
sw.R: Mfalme wa Israeli akamjibu Yehoshafati, "Yupo mtu mmoja zaidi ambaye tungeweza kumwuliza ili tujue {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema nini. Lakini mimi namchukia. Kamwe hasemi jambo jema juu yangu. Hunitabiria taabu tu. Jina lake ni Mikaya mwana wa Imla." Yehoshafati akasema, "Mtukufu mfalme, usiseme hivyo."

vi.L: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên nói với Giô-sa-phát: "Còn một người nữa để nhờ người ấy mà cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, nhưng tôi ghét hắn, vì hắn không nói tiên tri điều lành về tôi, mà chỉ điều dữ: đó là Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la." Giô-sa-phát nói: "Xin vua đừng nói như vậy."
vi.B: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên trả lời Giô-sa-phát: "Còn một người nữa có thể nhờ cầu hỏi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đó là Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la. Nhưng tôi ghét hắn, vì hắn chẳng bao giờ nói tiên tri điều lành về tôi, chỉ toàn điều dữ." Giô-sa-phát nói: "Xin vua đừng nói như vậy."
vi.R: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên trả lời Giô-sa-phát: "Còn một người nữa chúng ta có thể hỏi để biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế nào. Nhưng tôi ghét hắn. Hắn chẳng bao giờ nói điều gì tốt về tôi, chỉ toàn báo điều xấu. Tên hắn là Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la." Giô-sa-phát nói: "Thưa vua, vua không nên nói như vậy."

ko.L: 그러자 이스라엘 왕이 여호사밧에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈어 볼 사람이 아직 한 사람 있소. 그러나 나는 그를 미워하오. 그는 나에 대해 좋은 것은 예언하지 않고 나쁜 것만 예언하기 때문이오. 이믈라의 아들 미가야요." 그러자 여호사밧이 말했다. "왕께서는 그렇게 말씀하지 마시오."
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕이 여호사밧에게 대답했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 여쭈어 볼 수 있는 사람이 아직 하나 있소. 이믈라의 아들 미가야요. 그러나 나는 그를 미워하오. 그는 나에 대해 좋은 것은 하나도 예언하지 않고 언제나 나쁜 것만 예언하오." 여호사밧이 말했다. "왕께서는 그런 말씀을 하지 마시오."
ko.R: 이스라엘 왕이 여호사밧에게 대답했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 무엇이라고 하시는지 물어볼 수 있는 사람이 하나 더 있소. 그러나 나는 그를 미워하오. 그는 나에 대해 좋은 말은 한 번도 하지 않소. 언제나 나에게 나쁜 일이 생긴다고만 하오. 그의 이름은 이믈라의 아들 미가야요." 여호사밧이 말했다. "왕께서는 그런 말씀을 하시면 안 되오."

pt.L: E o rei de Israel disse a Josafá: "[Há] ainda um homem por meio de quem [se pode] consultar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, mas eu o odeio, porque ele não profetiza a meu respeito o bem, mas o mal: Micaías, filho de Inlá." E Josafá disse: "Não diga o rei assim."
pt.B: O rei de Israel respondeu a Josafá: "Ainda há um homem por meio de quem poderíamos consultar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Micaías, filho de Inlá. Mas eu o odeio, porque as profecias dele a meu respeito nunca são boas, só más." Josafá disse: "Que o rei não fale assim."
pt.R: O rei de Israel respondeu a Josafá: "Ainda há um homem a quem poderíamos perguntar o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz. Mas eu o odeio. Ele nunca diz nada de bom a meu respeito. Só anuncia desgraças para mim. O nome dele é Micaías, filho de Inlá." Josafá disse: "Majestade, o senhor não deveria dizer isso."

decisions.choice: good ... evil: good fortune ... disaster
decisions.reason: "Good" and "evil" here are what the prophecies promise: success or trouble. Ahab complains that Micaiah only ever announces harm for him.

decisions.choice: Micaiah son of Imlah: a prophet of Yahweh known only from this story
decisions.reason: His name means "Who is like Yahweh?" He is not the Micah of the book of Micah, who lived over a century later. Elijah is not mentioned in this chapter.

decisions.choice: let not the king say so: a polite rebuke
decisions.reason: Jehoshaphat speaks of Ahab in the third person, as was polite toward a king. He objects to Ahab's hatred for a prophet of Yahweh, or to the idea that a prophet speaks only to please.

decisions.choice: bad / trouble
decisions.reason: Balanced says "bad" and Readable "trouble" for the sense of "evil" here (m1); Literal keeps "evil".

decisions.choice: Your Majesty, you should not say that
decisions.reason: Readable turns the polite third person (m3) into a direct address.

decisions.choice: "Micaías hijo de Imla"
decisions.reason: The Kings and Chronicles terms table's form.

decisions.choice: "No diga eso el rey" (L, B); "Oh rey, no deberías decir eso" (R)
decisions.reason: Jehoshaphat speaks of the king in the third person, a courtesy Spanish can keep with the subjunctive; Readable turns to "tú" with "oh rey".

decisions.choice: "Michée fils de Yimla"
decisions.reason: The form of the terms note; the name is the same as the prophet Micah’s in French, and verse 28 itself quotes Micah 1:2.

decisions.choice: "Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form of Micaiah son of Imlah.

decisions.choice: Micaías, filho de Inlá
decisions.reason: For the whole book, the prophet's name (m2) takes the form set for Kings, "Micaías", kept apart from "Miqueias", the prophet of the book of Micah, as the meaning note asks; "Inlá" with the accent Portuguese needs for its final stress.

source.text: וַיִּקְרָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־סָרִ֖יס אֶחָ֑ד וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מַהֲרָ֖ה מִיכָ֥יְהוּ בֶן־יִמְלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And called [the] king of Israel to one official, and said, hurry [to bring] Micaiah son of Imlah.

en.L: And the king of Israel called to one official and said, "Hurry [to bring] Micaiah son of Imlah."
en.B: So the king of Israel called one of his court officials and said, "Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once."
en.R: So the king of Israel sent for one of his officials. He told him, "Go and get Micaiah son of Imlah. Hurry!"

es.L: Y el rey de Israel llamó a un funcionario y dijo: «[Trae] pronto a Micaías hijo de Imla».
es.B: Así que el rey de Israel llamó a uno de los funcionarios de la corte y le dijo: «Trae enseguida a Micaías hijo de Imla».
es.R: Así que el rey de Israel mandó llamar a uno de sus funcionarios. Le dijo: «Ve a buscar a Micaías hijo de Imla. ¡Date prisa!».

fr.L: Et le roi d’Israël appela un haut fonctionnaire et dit : « Vite, [fais venir] Michée fils de Yimla. »
fr.B: Le roi d’Israël appela donc un haut fonctionnaire de la cour et lui dit : « Fais venir tout de suite Michée, fils de Yimla. »
fr.R: Alors le roi d’Israël a fait venir un de ses fonctionnaires. Il lui a dit : « Va chercher Michée, fils de Yimla. Vite ! »

sw.L: Mfalme wa Israeli akamwita afisa mmoja, akasema, "Haraka [mlete] Mikaya mwana wa Imla."
sw.B: Basi mfalme wa Israeli akamwita mmoja wa maafisa wa ikulu, akasema, "Mlete Mikaya mwana wa Imla mara moja."
sw.R: Basi mfalme wa Israeli akamwita mmoja wa maafisa wake. Akamwambia, "Nenda ukamlete Mikaya mwana wa Imla. Fanya haraka!"

vi.L: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên gọi một viên quan và nói: "Hãy mau [đem] Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la [đến]."
vi.B: Vậy vua Y-sơ-ra-ên gọi một viên quan trong triều và bảo: "Hãy đem Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la đến đây ngay."
vi.R: Vậy vua Y-sơ-ra-ên cho gọi một viên quan. Vua bảo: "Hãy đi gọi Mi-chê con trai Giêm-la đến đây. Mau lên!"

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕이 한 내시를 불러 말했다. "이믈라의 아들 미가야를 속히 [데려오너라]."
ko.B: 그래서 이스라엘 왕은 관리 한 사람을 불러 말했다. "이믈라의 아들 미가야를 당장 데려오너라."
ko.R: 그래서 이스라엘 왕은 관리 한 사람을 불러 말했다. "가서 이믈라의 아들 미가야를 데려오너라. 서둘러라!"

pt.L: E o rei de Israel chamou um oficial e disse: "Depressa, [traga] Micaías, filho de Inlá."
pt.B: Então o rei de Israel chamou um dos seus oficiais da corte e disse: "Traga imediatamente Micaías, filho de Inlá."
pt.R: Então o rei de Israel mandou chamar um dos seus oficiais. Ele lhe disse: "Vá buscar Micaías, filho de Inlá. Depressa!"

decisions.choice: official: a court officer
decisions.reason: The word can mean a eunuch, but it is also the ordinary word for a high officer at a royal court, which is the sense here; nothing in the story turns on whether he was a eunuch.

decisions.choice: hurry Micaiah: bring Micaiah quickly
decisions.reason: The verb "hurry" takes Micaiah as its object: "make Micaiah come quickly".

decisions.choice: official
decisions.reason: Every level says "official" (m1). Literal may say "eunuch" where that sense matters; here it does not.

decisions.choice: "un funcionario"
decisions.reason: *saris*: the Kings and Chronicles table sets "eunucos" at Literal and "funcionarios" at Balanced and Readable; here the English Literal says "official", so Spanish keeps "funcionario" at every level.

decisions.choice: "un haut fonctionnaire" (L, B); "un de ses fonctionnaires" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English decision, every level says "official" here, since a eunuch is not the point; the French forms follow the Kings and Chronicles terms note for B and R.

decisions.choice: afisa (Literal); afisa wa ikulu (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The word here (*saris*) names a court officer; Swahili says "afisa" at every level rather than "towashi" (eunuch), as the English does here.

decisions.choice: "viên quan" for *saris* here
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "hoạn quan" for *sarisim* at Literal; here the English Literal reads "official" for a single court officer, so all levels say "viên quan".

decisions.choice: "내시" (L), "관리" (B, R) for *saris*
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the *sarisim*, held through Kings.

source.text: וּמֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל וִֽיהוֹשָׁפָ֣ט מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֡ה יֹשְׁבִים֩ אִ֨ישׁ עַל־כִּסְא֜וֹ מְלֻבָּשִׁ֤ים בְּגָדִים֙ בְּגֹ֔רֶן פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וְכָ֨ל־הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים מִֽתְנַבְּאִ֖ים לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah [were] sitting each on his throne, clothed [in] garments, at [the] threshing floor [at the] entrance of [the] gate of Samaria; and all the prophets [were] prophesying before them.

en.L: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah [were] sitting each on his throne, clothed in robes, at the threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets [were] prophesying before them.
en.B: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones, dressed in their royal robes, at the threshing floor at the entrance to the gate of Samaria, and all the prophets were prophesying in front of them.
en.R: The king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah sat on their thrones in their royal robes. They were at the threshing floor by the entrance to the city gate of Samaria. All the prophets were there in front of them, prophesying.

es.L: Y el rey de Israel y Josafat, rey de Judá, [estaban] sentados cada uno en su trono, vestidos con [sus] ropas, en la era a la entrada de la puerta de Samaria; y todos los profetas profetizaban delante de ellos.
es.B: El rey de Israel y Josafat, rey de Judá, estaban sentados en sus tronos, vestidos con sus ropas reales, en la era a la entrada de la puerta de Samaria, y todos los profetas profetizaban delante de ellos.
es.R: El rey de Israel y Josafat, rey de Judá, estaban sentados en sus tronos con sus ropas reales. Estaban en la era, junto a la entrada de la puerta de la ciudad de Samaria. Todos los profetas estaban allí delante de ellos, profetizando.

fr.L: Et le roi d’Israël et Josaphat, roi de Juda, [étaient] assis chacun sur son trône, revêtus de leurs habits, sur l’aire à l’entrée de la porte de Samarie ; et tous les prophètes prophétisaient devant eux.
fr.B: Le roi d’Israël et Josaphat, roi de Juda, étaient assis chacun sur son trône, vêtus de leurs habits royaux, sur l’aire à l’entrée de la porte de Samarie, et tous les prophètes prophétisaient devant eux.
fr.R: Le roi d’Israël et Josaphat, roi de Juda, étaient assis sur leurs trônes, dans leurs habits royaux. Ils étaient sur l’aire, près de l’entrée de la porte de Samarie. Tous les prophètes étaient là devant eux, en train de prophétiser.

sw.L: Mfalme wa Israeli na Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda [walikuwa] wameketi kila mmoja juu ya kiti chake cha enzi, wamevaa mavazi, kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka mlangoni pa lango la Samaria; na manabii wote [walikuwa] wakitabiri mbele yao.
sw.B: Wakati huo mfalme wa Israeli na Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda walikuwa wameketi juu ya viti vyao vya enzi, wamevaa mavazi yao ya kifalme, kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka karibu na lango la Samaria, na manabii wote walikuwa wakitabiri mbele yao.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Israeli na Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda walikuwa wameketi juu ya viti vyao vya enzi, wamevaa mavazi yao ya kifalme. Walikuwa kwenye uwanja wa kupuria nafaka karibu na lango la mji wa Samaria. Manabii wote walikuwa pale mbele yao wakitabiri.

vi.L: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa mỗi người ngồi trên ngai mình, mặc triều phục, tại sân đạp lúa ở lối vào cổng Sa-ma-ri; và tất cả các nhà tiên tri đang nói tiên tri trước mặt hai vua.
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa đang ngồi trên ngai mình, mặc triều phục, tại sân đạp lúa nơi lối vào cổng thành Sa-ma-ri, và tất cả các nhà tiên tri đang nói tiên tri trước mặt hai vua.
vi.R: Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa mặc triều phục, ngồi trên ngai của mình. Hai vua ngồi tại sân đạp lúa gần lối vào cổng thành Sa-ma-ri. Tất cả các nhà tiên tri đang nói tiên tri trước mặt hai vua.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕과 유다 왕 여호사밧은 사마리아 성문 어귀의 타작마당에서 예복을 입고 각자 자기 왕좌에 앉아 있었고, 모든 예언자가 그들 앞에서 예언하고 있었다.
ko.B: 그때 이스라엘 왕과 유다 왕 여호사밧은 왕의 예복을 입고 사마리아 성문 어귀에 있는 타작마당에서 각자 왕좌에 앉아 있었고, 모든 예언자가 그들 앞에서 예언하고 있었다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 왕과 유다 왕 여호사밧은 왕의 예복을 입고 각자 왕좌에 앉아 있었다. 그곳은 사마리아 성문 입구 가까이에 있는 타작마당이었다. 모든 예언자가 그들 앞에서 예언하고 있었다.

pt.L: E o rei de Israel e Josafá, rei de Judá, [estavam] sentados cada um no seu trono, vestidos com [os seus] mantos, na eira, à entrada da porta de Samaria; e todos os profetas [estavam] profetizando diante deles.
pt.B: O rei de Israel e Josafá, rei de Judá, estavam sentados nos seus tronos, vestidos com os seus mantos reais, na eira junto à entrada da porta de Samaria, e todos os profetas profetizavam diante deles.
pt.R: O rei de Israel e Josafá, rei de Judá, estavam sentados nos seus tronos, vestidos com os seus mantos reais. Eles estavam na eira, perto da entrada da porta da cidade de Samaria. Todos os profetas estavam ali diante deles, profetizando.

decisions.choice: clothed in garments: wearing royal robes
decisions.reason: "Garments" here are the formal robes of kings seated in state. The scene is a public royal assembly.

decisions.choice: the threshing floor at the gate of Samaria: a broad open space outside the city gate
decisions.reason: A threshing floor was a flat, open area of hard ground. One by the city gate made room for the two kings' thrones and the crowd of four hundred prophets. The gate was the place for public business and judgment.

decisions.choice: prophesying: speaking as prophets, perhaps with ecstatic behavior
decisions.reason: The verb form can describe a prophet's words or the excited behavior that sometimes went with prophecy (1 Samuel 10:5-6; 18:29 in this book). Here the next verses show both actions and words.

decisions.choice: royal robes
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "royal" to show what kind of robes these were (m1).

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ צִדְקִיָּ֥ה בֶֽן־כְּנַעֲנָ֖ה קַרְנֵ֣י בַרְזֶ֑ל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בְּאֵ֛לֶּה תְּנַגַּ֥ח אֶת־אֲרָ֖ם עַד־כַּלֹּתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And made for himself Zedekiah son of Chenaanah horns of iron, and said, thus says Yahweh, with these you will gore Aram until finishing them.

en.L: And Zedekiah son of Chenaanah made for himself horns of iron and said, "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: 'With these you will gore Aram until they are finished.'"
en.B: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah had made himself iron horns, and he said, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: 'With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed.'"
en.R: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah had made some horns out of iron. He said, "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: 'With horns like these you will gore the Arameans and wipe them out.'"

es.L: Y Sedequías hijo de Quenaana se hizo unos cuernos de hierro y dijo: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: “Con estos acornearás a Aram hasta acabar con ellos”».
es.B: Sedequías hijo de Quenaana se había hecho unos cuernos de hierro, y dijo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: “Con estos acornearás a los arameos hasta destruirlos”».
es.R: Sedequías hijo de Quenaana había hecho unos cuernos de hierro. Dijo: «Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: “Con cuernos como estos acornearás a los arameos y acabarás con ellos”».

fr.L: Et Sédécias fils de Kenaana se fit des cornes de fer et dit : « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : “Avec celles-ci tu frapperas Aram jusqu’à les anéantir.” »
fr.B: Sédécias, fils de Kenaana, s’était fait des cornes de fer, et il dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : “Avec ces cornes, tu enfonceras les Araméens jusqu’à les détruire.” »
fr.R: Sédécias, fils de Kenaana, avait fabriqué des cornes en fer. Il a dit : « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : “Avec des cornes comme celles-ci, tu enfonceras les Araméens et tu les anéantiras.” »

sw.L: Sedekia mwana wa Kenaana akajitengenezea pembe za chuma, akasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: 'Kwa hizi utawapiga pembe Aramu mpaka wamalizike.'"
sw.B: Sedekia mwana wa Kenaana alikuwa amejitengenezea pembe za chuma, akasema, "Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: 'Kwa hizi utawapiga pembe Waaramu mpaka waangamie.'"
sw.R: Sedekia mwana wa Kenaana alikuwa ametengeneza pembe za chuma. Akasema, "Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: 'Kwa pembe kama hizi utawapiga Waaramu na kuwaangamiza.'"

vi.L: Sê-đê-kia con trai Kê-na-na làm cho mình những cái sừng bằng sắt và nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: 'Với những sừng này, ngươi sẽ húc A-ram cho đến khi chúng bị tiêu diệt.'"
vi.B: Sê-đê-kia con trai Kê-na-na đã làm cho mình những cái sừng bằng sắt, và nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: 'Với những sừng này, vua sẽ húc quân A-ram cho đến khi chúng bị tiêu diệt.'"
vi.R: Sê-đê-kia con trai Kê-na-na đã làm mấy cái sừng bằng sắt. Ông nói: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: 'Với những cái sừng như thế này, vua sẽ húc quân A-ram và tiêu diệt chúng.'"

ko.L: 그리고 그나아나의 아들 시드기야가 자기를 위해 쇠뿔들을 만들고 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하십니다. '네가 이것들로 아람을 찔러 그들을 끝장낼 것이다.'"
ko.B: 그나아나의 아들 시드기야는 쇠로 뿔들을 만들어 가지고 와서 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하십니다. '너는 이 뿔들로 아람 사람들을 찔러 멸망시킬 것이다.'"
ko.R: 그나아나의 아들 시드기야는 쇠로 뿔들을 만들어 왔다. 그가 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀입니다. '너는 이런 뿔로 아람 사람들을 들이받아 모두 없애 버릴 것이다.'"

pt.L: E Zedequias, filho de Quenaaná, fez para si chifres de ferro e disse: "Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: 'Com estes chifrarás Arã até acabar com eles.'"
pt.B: Zedequias, filho de Quenaaná, tinha feito para si chifres de ferro, e disse: "Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: 'Com estes chifrarás os arameus até destruí-los.'"
pt.R: Zedequias, filho de Quenaaná, tinha feito uns chifres de ferro. Ele disse: "É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: 'Com chifres como estes vais atacar os arameus e acabar com eles.'"

decisions.choice: horns of iron: a sign acted out by the prophet
decisions.reason: Prophets sometimes acted out their message (11:29-31; 2 Kings 13:15-19). The horn of a bull stands for strength and conquest (Deuteronomy 33:17). With iron horns Zedekiah pictures the king as a bull goring Aram to death.

decisions.choice: made: had made, before the scene
decisions.reason: The horns were most likely made before the assembly at the gate, and Zedekiah now shows them; the verb does not require that he made them on the spot.

decisions.choice: Aram: the Aramean people and army
decisions.reason: The country's name stands for its people and army, as the plural "them" at the end shows.

decisions.choice: The LORD says this / This is what the LORD says
decisions.reason: The messenger formula "thus says Yahweh" has one wording at each level in these books. Balanced and Readable name the Arameans (m3).

decisions.choice: "Sedequías hijo de Quenaana"
decisions.reason: Sedequías as the terms table sets for the king of the same name; Quenaana is the usual Spanish form of Chenaanah.

decisions.choice: "Sédécias fils de Kenaana"
decisions.reason: Sédécias as the terms note gives for the king of that name; Kenaana in the usual French spelling.

decisions.choice: "Sê-đê-kia con trai Kê-na-na"
decisions.reason: The court prophet takes the same form as King Zedekiah in the terms note; "con trai Kê-na-na" keeps them apart.

decisions.choice: Zedequias, filho de Quenaaná; chifrarás
decisions.reason: "Zedequias", the usual Brazilian form of the name, and "Quenaaná" for the father. The oracle Zedekiah gives as the LORD's word speaks to the king with "tu", as the LORD's words do throughout the book (20:13); the narrative, not the wording, shows that it is false. "Chifrar" is the plain Portuguese verb for goring with horns, so the acted sign (m1) can be followed.

decisions.choice: atacar
decisions.reason: Readable says "atacar" with horns, since "chifrar" is not an everyday word for young readers; the horns are kept.

source.text: וְכָל־הַנְּבִאִ֔ים נִבְּאִ֥ים כֵּ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר עֲלֵ֞ה רָמֹ֤ת גִּלְעָד֙ וְהַצְלַ֔ח וְנָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And all the prophets [were] prophesying so, saying, go up [to] Ramoth-gilead and succeed, and will give Yahweh [it] into [the] hand of the king.

en.L: And all the prophets [were] prophesying so, saying, "Go up [to] Ramoth-gilead and succeed, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give [it] into the hand of the king."
en.B: All the prophets were prophesying the same thing: "Go up to Ramoth-gilead and be victorious. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will give it into the king's hand."
en.R: All the other prophets were saying the same thing: "Attack Ramoth-gilead and win the battle! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will help you capture it, Your Majesty."

es.L: Y todos los profetas profetizaban así, diciendo: «Sube [a] Ramot de Galaad y triunfa, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [la] entregará en mano del rey».
es.B: Todos los profetas profetizaban lo mismo: «Sube a Ramot de Galaad y triunfa. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} la entregará en manos del rey».
es.R: Todos los demás profetas decían lo mismo: «¡Ataca Ramot de Galaad y gana la batalla! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ayudará a conquistarla, oh rey».

fr.L: Et tous les prophètes prophétisaient ainsi, en disant : « Monte [à] Ramoth de Galaad et réussis, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [la] livrera entre les mains du roi. »
fr.B: Tous les prophètes prophétisaient de même : « Monte à Ramoth de Galaad, et tu seras victorieux. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} la livrera entre les mains du roi. »
fr.R: Tous les autres prophètes disaient la même chose : « Attaque Ramoth de Galaad, et tu gagneras la bataille ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’aidera à la prendre, ô roi. »

sw.L: Manabii wote [walikuwa] wakitabiri vivyo hivyo, wakisema, "Panda [uende] Ramoth-gileadi, ufanikiwe, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ataitia] mkononi mwa mfalme."
sw.B: Manabii wote walikuwa wakitabiri jambo lile lile: "Panda Ramoth-gileadi ushinde. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataitia mkononi mwa mfalme."
sw.R: Manabii wengine wote walikuwa wakisema jambo lile lile: "Ushambulie Ramoth-gileadi na ushinde vita! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakusaidia kuuteka, Mtukufu mfalme."

vi.L: Tất cả các nhà tiên tri đều nói tiên tri như vậy, rằng: "Xin vua đi lên Ra-mốt Ga-la-át và sẽ thắng, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ phó [thành ấy] vào tay vua."
vi.B: Tất cả các nhà tiên tri đều nói tiên tri như vậy: "Xin vua đi lên Ra-mốt Ga-la-át và sẽ chiến thắng. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ phó thành ấy vào tay vua."
vi.R: Tất cả các nhà tiên tri khác cũng nói y như vậy: "Thưa đức vua, xin hãy tấn công Ra-mốt Ga-la-át và đức vua sẽ thắng! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giúp đức vua chiếm được thành ấy."

ko.L: 그리고 모든 예언자가 그렇게 예언하며 말했다. "길르앗 라못으로 올라가서 승리하십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 [그것을] 임금님의 손에 넘겨주실 것입니다."
ko.B: 모든 예언자가 똑같이 예언했다. "길르앗 라못으로 올라가서 승리하십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 성을 임금님의 손에 넘겨주실 것입니다."
ko.R: 다른 예언자들도 모두 똑같이 말했다. "길르앗 라못을 치십시오. 싸움에서 이기실 것입니다! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 임금님이 그 성을 차지하도록 도와주실 것입니다."

pt.L: E todos os profetas [estavam] profetizando assim, dizendo: "Suba [a] Ramote-Gileade e tenha sucesso, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [a] entregará na mão do rei."
pt.B: Todos os profetas profetizavam a mesma coisa: "Suba a Ramote-Gileade e saia vitorioso. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} a entregará nas mãos do rei."
pt.R: Todos os outros profetas diziam a mesma coisa: "Ataque Ramote-Gileade e vença a batalha! {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai lhe dar a vitória sobre a cidade, Majestade."

decisions.choice: succeed: prosper, win
decisions.reason: The verb means to succeed or prosper; in a battle it means victory. Micaiah repeats the words mockingly in verse 15.

decisions.choice: will give into the hand of the king: as in verse 6, now with the divine name
decisions.reason: This time the prophets use the name Yahweh. As in verse 6 the Hebrew leaves the object unstated.

decisions.choice: help you capture it, Your Majesty
decisions.reason: As in verse 6.

source.text: וְהַמַּלְאָ֞ךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַ֣ךְ׀לִקְרֹ֣א מִיכָ֗יְהוּ דִּבֶּ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּה־נָ֞א דִּבְרֵ֧י הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים פֶּֽה־אֶחָ֥ד ט֖וֹב אֶל־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ יְהִֽי־נָ֣א דְבָרְךָ֗ כִּדְבַ֛ר אַחַ֥ד מֵהֶ֖ם וְדִבַּ֥רְתָּ טּֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: And the messenger who had gone to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, look please, [the] words of the prophets [are with] one mouth good to the king; let be please your word like [the] word of one of them, and you will speak good.

en.L: And the messenger who had gone to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, "Look, please, the words of the prophets [are] one mouth, good to the king. Let your word, please, be like the word of one of them, and speak good."
en.B: The messenger who had gone to call Micaiah said to him, "Listen, the prophets are all speaking with one voice, and what they say is good for the king. Please let your word be like one of theirs, and speak favorably."
en.R: The messenger who went to get Micaiah said to him, "Listen! All the other prophets agree. They are all promising the king success. Please say the same thing they are saying. Give him a good message."

es.L: Y el mensajero que había ido a llamar a Micaías le habló, diciendo: «Mira, por favor, las palabras de los profetas [son] a una boca buenas para el rey. Sea, por favor, tu palabra como la palabra de uno de ellos, y habla bien».
es.B: El mensajero que había ido a llamar a Micaías le dijo: «Escucha, los profetas hablan todos a una voz, y lo que dicen es favorable al rey. Por favor, que tu palabra sea como la de ellos, y habla favorablemente».
es.R: El mensajero que fue a buscar a Micaías le dijo: «¡Escucha! Todos los demás profetas están de acuerdo. Todos le prometen éxito al rey. Por favor, di lo mismo que ellos. Dale un buen mensaje».

fr.L: Et le messager qui était allé appeler Michée lui parla en disant : « Voici donc, les paroles des prophètes [sont] d’une seule bouche, favorables au roi. Que ta parole, je te prie, soit comme la parole de l’un d’eux, et dis du bien. »
fr.B: Le messager qui était allé appeler Michée lui dit : « Écoute, les prophètes parlent d’une seule voix, et ce qu’ils disent est favorable au roi. Je t’en prie, que ta parole soit comme la leur, et annonce du bien. »
fr.R: Le messager qui était allé chercher Michée lui a dit : « Écoute ! Tous les autres prophètes sont d’accord. Ils promettent tous la victoire au roi. S’il te plaît, dis la même chose qu’eux. Donne-lui un bon message. »

sw.L: Mjumbe aliyekwenda kumwita Mikaya akamwambia, akisema, "Tazama, tafadhali, maneno ya manabii [ni] kinywa kimoja, mema kwa mfalme. Tafadhali, neno lako na liwe kama neno la mmoja wao, useme mema."
sw.B: Mjumbe aliyekwenda kumwita Mikaya akamwambia, "Sikiliza, manabii wote wanasema kwa sauti moja, na wanayoyasema ni mema kwa mfalme. Tafadhali neno lako na liwe kama la mmoja wao, useme mema."
sw.R: Mjumbe aliyekwenda kumwita Mikaya akamwambia, "Sikiliza! Manabii wengine wote wanakubaliana. Wote wanamwahidi mfalme ushindi. Tafadhali sema kama wanavyosema wao. Mpe ujumbe mzuri."

vi.L: Sứ giả đã đi gọi Mi-chê nói với ông rằng: "Kìa, lời của các nhà tiên tri đồng một miệng, [nói điều] lành cho vua. Xin lời ông cũng như lời của một người trong họ, và hãy nói điều lành."
vi.B: Sứ giả đi gọi Mi-chê nói với ông: "Này, các nhà tiên tri đều đồng một lời nói điều lành cho vua. Xin ông cũng nói như họ, và hãy nói điều lành."
vi.R: Người sứ giả đi gọi Mi-chê nói với ông: "Ông nghe đây! Tất cả các nhà tiên tri khác đều đồng ý với nhau. Họ đều hứa vua sẽ thắng. Xin ông cũng nói giống như họ. Hãy báo cho vua một tin tốt."

ko.L: 그리고 미가야를 부르러 간 사자가 그에게 말했다. "보시오, 예언자들의 말이 한 입으로 왕께 좋게 [말하고 있소]. 부디 당신의 말도 그들 가운데 하나의 말과 같게 하여 좋게 말하시오."
ko.B: 미가야를 부르러 간 사자가 그에게 말했다. "들어 보시오. 예언자들이 모두 한목소리로 왕께 좋은 말을 하고 있소. 당신도 그들처럼 좋게 말해 주시오."
ko.R: 미가야를 데리러 간 사자가 그에게 말했다. "들어 보시오! 다른 예언자들은 모두 한목소리로 왕이 이길 것이라고 하고 있소. 당신도 그들과 똑같이 말해 주시오. 왕에게 좋은 말을 해 주시오."

pt.L: E o mensageiro que tinha ido chamar Micaías lhe falou, dizendo: "Veja, por favor, as palavras dos profetas [são] uma só boca, boas para o rei. Que a sua palavra, por favor, seja como a palavra de um deles, e fale o bem."
pt.B: O mensageiro que tinha ido chamar Micaías lhe disse: "Escute: os profetas estão falando a uma só voz, e o que dizem é bom para o rei. Por favor, que a sua palavra seja como a de um deles; fale coisas favoráveis."
pt.R: O mensageiro que foi buscar Micaías lhe disse: "Escute! Todos os outros profetas concordam. Todos estão prometendo sucesso ao rei. Por favor, diga o mesmo que eles estão dizendo. Dê ao rei uma boa mensagem."

decisions.choice: one mouth: with one voice, in full agreement
decisions.reason: "One mouth" means that the prophets all say the same thing.

decisions.choice: good: favorable, promising success
decisions.reason: As in verse 8, "good" is a message of success for the king. The messenger presses Micaiah to agree with the others.

decisions.choice: speaking with one voice / all agree
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the English idiom closest to "one mouth"; Readable says what it means (m1).

decisions.choice: the messenger and Micaiah speak to each other in 하오체
decisions.reason: A court official addressing a prophet he has been sent to fetch: courteous without deference, as Elijah and Obadiah in chapter 18.

source.text: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִיכָ֑יְהוּ חַי־יְהוָ֕ה כִּ֠י אֶת־אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֹאמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י אֹת֥וֹ אֲדַבֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Micaiah, [by the] life of Yahweh, that what will say Yahweh to me, it I will speak.

en.L: And Micaiah said, "[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says to me, that I will speak."
en.B: But Micaiah said, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, whatever {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says to me is what I will speak."
en.R: But Micaiah said, "I promise, as surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives, I will say only what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} tells me to say."

es.L: Y Micaías dijo: «Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me diga, eso hablaré».
es.B: Pero Micaías dijo: «Tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me diga, eso diré».
es.R: Pero Micaías dijo: «Te lo aseguro, tan cierto como que vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, diré solamente lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me mande decir».

fr.L: Et Michée dit : « [Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dira, c’est cela que je dirai. »
fr.B: Mais Michée répondit : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dira, c’est cela que je dirai. »
fr.R: Mais Michée a dit : « Je te le jure, aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant, je dirai seulement ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} me dira de dire. »

sw.L: Mikaya akasema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, lile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakaloniambia, ndilo nitakalosema."
sw.B: Lakini Mikaya akasema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, lolote {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakaloniambia ndilo nitakalolisema."
sw.R: Lakini Mikaya akasema, "Nakuahidi, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo, nitasema tu yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakayoniambia niseme."

vi.L: Mi-chê nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, điều gì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi, tôi sẽ nói điều ấy."
vi.B: Nhưng Mi-chê nói: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với tôi điều gì, tôi sẽ nói điều ấy."
vi.R: Nhưng Mi-chê nói: "Tôi xin thề, thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống, tôi chỉ nói điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bảo tôi nói mà thôi."

ko.L: 그러자 미가야가 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내게 말씀하시는 것, 그것을 내가 말하겠소."
ko.B: 그러나 미가야가 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내게 말씀하시는 것만 말하겠소."
ko.R: 그러나 미가야가 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하는데, 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내게 말하라고 하시는 것만 말하겠소."

pt.L: E Micaías disse: "[Tão certo como] vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disser, isso falarei."
pt.B: Mas Micaías disse: "Tão certo como vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disser, isso é o que falarei."
pt.R: Mas Micaías disse: "Eu prometo: tão certo como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} vive, vou dizer somente o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me mandar dizer."

decisions.choice: as Yahweh lives: an oath
decisions.reason: Micaiah binds himself by an oath in Yahweh's name, the strongest form of promise. He will not shape his message to please the king.

decisions.choice: what Yahweh says to me, that I will speak: the mark of a true prophet
decisions.reason: A prophet of Yahweh speaks only the words Yahweh gives him (Numbers 22:38; Deuteronomy 18:18). Micaiah's oath sets him apart from prophets who say what the king wants to hear.

decisions.choice: I promise
decisions.reason: Readable adds "I promise" to show that "as surely as the LORD lives" is an oath (m1).

decisions.choice: Tão certo como vive o SENHOR
decisions.reason: The oath (m1) keeps the wording set for the whole book at 1:29, "[Tão certo como] vive o SENHOR" at Literal and "Tão certo como vive o SENHOR" at Balanced, as 1 Samuel has it in Portuguese.

source.text: וַיָּבוֹא֮ אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ אֵלָ֗יו מִיכָ֨יְהוּ֙ הֲנֵלֵ֞ךְ אֶל־רָמֹ֥ת גִּלְעָ֛ד לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אִם־נֶחְדָּ֑ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ עֲלֵ֣ה וְהַצְלַ֔ח וְנָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַ֥ד הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he came to the king, and said the king to him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead for battle, or shall we refrain? And he said to him, go up and succeed, and will give Yahweh [it] into [the] hand of the king.

en.L: And he came to the king, and the king said to him, "Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead for battle, or shall we refrain?" And he said to him, "Go up and succeed, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give [it] into the hand of the king."
en.B: When he came to the king, the king asked him, "Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or shall we hold back?" He answered, "Go up and be victorious. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will give it into the king's hand."
en.R: When Micaiah came, the king said, "Micaiah, should we march on Ramoth-gilead, or not?" Micaiah answered, "Attack and win the battle! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will help you capture it, Your Majesty."

es.L: Y llegó ante el rey, y el rey le dijo: «Micaías, ¿iremos a Ramot de Galaad a la batalla, o desistiremos?». Y él le dijo: «Sube y triunfa, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [la] entregará en mano del rey».
es.B: Cuando llegó ante el rey, el rey le preguntó: «Micaías, ¿debemos ir a la guerra contra Ramot de Galaad, o debemos desistir?». Él le respondió: «Sube y triunfa. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} la entregará en manos del rey».
es.R: Cuando Micaías llegó, el rey le dijo: «Micaías, ¿debemos atacar Ramot de Galaad, o no?». Micaías respondió: «¡Ataca y gana la batalla! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ayudará a conquistarla, oh rey».

fr.L: Et il vint vers le roi, et le roi lui dit : « Michée, irons-nous contre Ramoth de Galaad pour combattre, ou nous en abstiendrons-nous ? » Et il lui dit : « Monte et réussis, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [la] livrera entre les mains du roi. »
fr.B: Quand il arriva auprès du roi, celui-ci lui demanda : « Michée, devons-nous partir en guerre contre Ramoth de Galaad, ou devons-nous y renoncer ? » Il répondit : « Monte, et tu seras victorieux. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} la livrera entre les mains du roi. »
fr.R: Quand Michée est arrivé, le roi lui a dit : « Michée, devons-nous attaquer Ramoth de Galaad, ou pas ? » Michée a répondu : « Attaque, et tu gagneras la bataille ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’aidera à la prendre, ô roi. »

sw.L: Akafika kwa mfalme, naye mfalme akamwambia, "Mikaya, je, twende Ramoth-gileadi vitani, au tuache?" Akamwambia, "Panda ufanikiwe, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ataitia] mkononi mwa mfalme."
sw.B: Alipofika kwa mfalme, mfalme akamwuliza, "Mikaya, je, twende vitani kupigana na Ramoth-gileadi, au tujizuie?" Akajibu, "Panda ushinde. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataitia mkononi mwa mfalme."
sw.R: Mikaya alipofika, mfalme akasema, "Mikaya, je, tuende kuushambulia Ramoth-gileadi, au tusiende?" Mikaya akajibu, "Ushambulie na ushinde vita! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakusaidia kuuteka, Mtukufu mfalme."

vi.L: Ông đến gặp vua, và vua hỏi ông: "Mi-chê, chúng ta có nên đi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không, hay chúng ta nên thôi?" Ông đáp: "Xin vua đi lên và sẽ thắng, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ phó [thành ấy] vào tay vua."
vi.B: Khi ông đến, vua hỏi: "Mi-chê, chúng ta có nên đi đánh Ra-mốt Ga-la-át không, hay nên dừng lại?" Ông đáp: "Xin vua cứ đi lên và sẽ chiến thắng. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ phó thành ấy vào tay vua."
vi.R: Khi Mi-chê đến, vua hỏi: "Mi-chê, chúng ta có nên tấn công Ra-mốt Ga-la-át hay không?" Mi-chê trả lời: "Thưa đức vua, xin cứ tấn công và đức vua sẽ thắng! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ giúp đức vua chiếm được thành ấy."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 왕에게 오자, 왕이 그에게 말했다. "미가야야, 우리가 길르앗 라못으로 싸우러 가야 하겠느냐, 그만두어야 하겠느냐?" 그러자 그가 그에게 말했다. "올라가서 승리하십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 [그것을] 임금님의 손에 넘겨주실 것입니다."
ko.B: 그가 왕에게 오자 왕이 그에게 물었다. "미가야야, 우리가 길르앗 라못을 치러 가야 하겠느냐, 그만두어야 하겠느냐?" 미가야가 대답했다. "올라가서 승리하십시오. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 성을 임금님의 손에 넘겨주실 것입니다."
ko.R: 미가야가 오자 왕이 말했다. "미가야야, 우리가 길르앗 라못을 치러 가야 하겠느냐, 말아야 하겠느냐?" 미가야가 대답했다. "가서 싸우십시오. 이기실 것입니다! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 임금님이 그 성을 차지하도록 도와주실 것입니다."

pt.L: E ele veio ao rei, e o rei lhe disse: "Micaías, iremos a Ramote-Gileade para a batalha, ou desistiremos?" E ele lhe disse: "Suba e tenha sucesso, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} [a] entregará na mão do rei."
pt.B: Quando ele chegou diante do rei, o rei lhe perguntou: "Micaías, devemos ir à guerra contra Ramote-Gileade, ou devemos desistir?" Ele respondeu: "Suba e saia vitorioso. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} a entregará nas mãos do rei."
pt.R: Quando Micaías chegou, o rei disse: "Micaías, devemos atacar Ramote-Gileade, ou não?" Micaías respondeu: "Ataque e vença a batalha! {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai lhe dar a vitória sobre a cidade, Majestade."

decisions.choice: go up and succeed: the other prophets' words repeated, not Micaiah's real message
decisions.reason: Micaiah answers with the exact words of the four hundred (verse 12). The king's reply in verse 16 shows that he heard them as mockery, or at least knew they were not what Micaiah had received from Yahweh. Micaiah gives his true message in verse 17.

decisions.choice: shall we go: the king now includes Jehoshaphat
decisions.reason: In verse 6 the king asked "shall I go"; now, in front of Jehoshaphat, he says "we".

decisions.choice: help you capture it, Your Majesty
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the same wording as in verse 12, so the reader can see that Micaiah repeats the prophets.

decisions.choice: Ahab speaks to Micaiah in 해라체; Micaiah answers in 합쇼체
alternatives: 하오체 from Ahab, as to the prophet in 20:14
decisions.reason: Ahab hates Micaiah (verse 8) and speaks down to him, as to Elijah in 18:17; Micaiah keeps the 합쇼체 the terms note sets for prophets speaking to kings.

decisions.choice: the words of verse 12 repeated at each level
decisions.reason: Micaiah answers in the very words of the four hundred (m1), so each level repeats its own wording of verse 12, the courtly "o rei" and Readable's "Majestade" included; his own words to the king elsewhere say "você", as a prophet speaks to a king in this book (verse 28; 13:6-8).

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַד־כַּמֶּ֥ה פְעָמִ֖ים אֲנִ֣י מַשְׁבִּעֶ֑ךָ אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא־תְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛י רַק־אֱמֶ֖ת בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to him the king, until how many times [am] I making you swear that not you will speak to me only truth in [the] name of Yahweh?

en.L: And the king said to him, "How many times must I make you swear that you will speak to me nothing but truth in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?"
en.B: But the king said to him, "How often must I put you under oath to tell me only the truth in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?"
en.R: But the king said to him, "How often must I say this? Swear in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that you will tell me only the truth!"

es.L: Y el rey le dijo: «¿Hasta cuántas veces te haré jurar que no me digas sino la verdad en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?».
es.B: Pero el rey le dijo: «¿Cuántas veces tengo que hacerte jurar que me digas solo la verdad en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?».
es.R: Pero el rey le dijo: «¿Cuántas veces tengo que decírtelo? ¡Jura en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que me dirás solo la verdad!».

fr.L: Et le roi lui dit : « Combien de fois devrai-je te faire jurer de ne me dire que la vérité au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? »
fr.B: Mais le roi lui dit : « Combien de fois devrai-je t’adjurer de ne me dire que la vérité au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? »
fr.R: Mais le roi lui a dit : « Combien de fois faudra-t-il que je te le dise ? Jure-moi au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que tu ne me diras que la vérité ! »

sw.L: Mfalme akamwambia, "Ni mara ngapi nikuapishe kwamba usiniambie ila kweli tu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?"
sw.B: Lakini mfalme akamwambia, "Ni mara ngapi nikuapishe uniambie kweli tu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?"
sw.R: Lakini mfalme akamwambia, "Ni mara ngapi lazima niseme jambo hili? Apa kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwamba utaniambia kweli tu!"

vi.L: Vua nói với ông: "Ta phải bắt ông thề bao nhiêu lần để ông nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà chỉ nói sự thật với ta?"
vi.B: Nhưng vua nói với ông: "Ta phải bắt ông thề bao nhiêu lần nữa để ông nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà chỉ nói sự thật với ta?"
vi.R: Nhưng vua nói với ông: "Ta phải nói điều này bao nhiêu lần nữa? Hãy nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà thề rằng ông sẽ chỉ nói sự thật với ta!"

ko.L: 그러자 왕이 그에게 말했다. "너에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 진실만을 내게 말하라고 내가 몇 번이나 맹세하게 해야 하겠느냐?"
ko.B: 그러자 왕이 그에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 진실만을 말하라고 내가 몇 번이나 너에게 맹세를 시켜야 하겠느냐?"
ko.R: 그러자 왕이 그에게 말했다. "내가 몇 번이나 말해야 하겠느냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 맹세하고 나에게 진실만을 말하여라!"

pt.L: E o rei lhe disse: "Até quantas vezes [tenho de] fazer você jurar que não me falará senão a verdade em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}?"
pt.B: Mas o rei lhe disse: "Quantas vezes vou ter de fazer você jurar que me dirá somente a verdade em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}?"
pt.R: Mas o rei lhe disse: "Quantas vezes vou ter de dizer isto? Jure em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que vai me dizer só a verdade!"
