source.text: וְאִ֗ישׁ מָשַׁ֤ךְ בַּקֶּ֨שֶׁת֙ לְתֻמּ֔וֹ וַיַּכֶּה֙ אֶת־מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בֵּ֥ין הַדְּבָקִ֖ים וּבֵ֣ין הַשִּׁרְיָ֑ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְרַכָּב֗וֹ הֲפֹ֥ךְ יָדְךָ֛ וְהוֹצִיאֵ֥נִי מִן־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה כִּ֥י הָחֳלֵֽיתִי׃

records.literal_gloss: And a man drew on the bow in his innocence and struck [the] king of Israel between the scales and between the armor; and he said to his chariot driver, turn your hand and bring me out from the camp, for I am wounded.

en.L: And a man drew the bow at random and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor and the breastplate. And he said to his chariot driver, "Turn your hand and take me out of the camp, for I am wounded."
en.B: But a man drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the joints of his scale armor and the breastplate. The king said to his chariot driver, "Turn around and get me out of the battle, because I am wounded."
en.R: But an Aramean soldier shot an arrow without aiming at anyone in particular. It hit the king of Israel where his armor joined together. The king said to the driver of his chariot, "Turn around and take me away from the fighting! I am wounded."

es.L: Y un hombre tensó el arco al azar e hirió al rey de Israel entre las junturas de la armadura y la coraza. Y él dijo a su conductor del carro: «Vuelve tu mano y sácame del campamento, porque estoy herido».
es.B: Pero un hombre disparó su arco al azar e hirió al rey de Israel entre las junturas de su armadura de escamas y la coraza. El rey le dijo al conductor de su carro: «Da la vuelta y sácame de la batalla, porque estoy herido».
es.R: Pero un soldado arameo disparó una flecha sin apuntar a nadie en particular. La flecha hirió al rey de Israel donde se unían las piezas de su armadura. El rey le dijo al conductor de su carro: «¡Da la vuelta y sácame de la pelea! Estoy herido».

fr.L: Et un homme tira de l’arc au hasard et frappa le roi d’Israël entre les jointures de l’armure et la cuirasse. Et il dit à son conducteur de char : « Tourne ta main et fais-moi sortir du camp, car je suis blessé. »
fr.B: Mais un homme tira une flèche au hasard et atteignit le roi d’Israël entre les jointures de sa cotte d’écailles et sa cuirasse. Le roi dit à son conducteur de char : « Fais demi-tour et sors-moi de la bataille, car je suis blessé. »
fr.R: Mais un soldat araméen a tiré une flèche sans viser personne en particulier. La flèche a atteint le roi d’Israël à l’endroit où les pièces de son armure se rejoignaient. Le roi a dit au conducteur de son char : « Fais demi-tour et emmène-moi loin des combats ! Je suis blessé. »

sw.L: Mtu mmoja akavuta upinde wake bila kukusudia, akampiga mfalme wa Israeli kati ya viungo vya deraya na kifuko cha kifua. Akamwambia dereva wa gari lake, "Geuza mkono wako, unitoe kambini, kwa maana nimejeruhiwa."
sw.B: Lakini mtu mmoja akavuta upinde wake bila kulenga mtu fulani, akampiga mfalme wa Israeli kati ya viungo vya deraya yake ya magamba na kifuko cha kifua. Mfalme akamwambia dereva wa gari lake, "Geuza unitoe vitani, kwa sababu nimejeruhiwa."
sw.R: Lakini askari mmoja wa Kiaramu akapiga mshale bila kumlenga mtu yeyote hasa. Mshale ukampiga mfalme wa Israeli mahali ambapo vipande vya deraya yake viliungana. Mfalme akamwambia dereva wa gari lake, "Geuza uniondoe vitani! Nimejeruhiwa."

vi.L: Có một người tình cờ giương cung bắn trúng vua Y-sơ-ra-ên giữa chỗ nối của áo giáp và tấm che ngực. Vua nói với người đánh xe: "Hãy quay tay lại và đưa ta ra khỏi trại quân, vì ta bị thương rồi."
vi.B: Nhưng có một người tình cờ giương cung bắn, trúng vua Y-sơ-ra-ên ngay chỗ nối giữa các mảnh giáp và tấm che ngực. Vua bảo người đánh xe: "Hãy quay xe lại và đưa ta ra khỏi trận, vì ta bị thương rồi."
vi.R: Nhưng có một người lính A-ram bắn tên mà không nhắm vào ai cả. Mũi tên trúng vua Y-sơ-ra-ên ngay chỗ các mảnh áo giáp nối với nhau. Vua bảo người đánh xe: "Hãy quay xe lại và đưa ta ra khỏi trận! Ta bị thương rồi."

ko.L: 그리고 한 사람이 무심코 활을 당겨 이스라엘 왕의 갑옷 이음새와 가슴받이 사이를 맞혔다. 그러자 그가 자기 병거 모는 자에게 말했다. "네 손을 돌려 나를 진에서 데리고 나가거라. 내가 부상을 입었다."
ko.B: 그런데 한 군사가 무심코 활을 당겼는데, 그 화살이 이스라엘 왕의 비늘 갑옷 이음새와 가슴받이 사이를 맞혔다. 왕이 자기 병거 모는 병사에게 말했다. "병거를 돌려 나를 싸움터에서 빠져나가게 하여라. 내가 부상을 입었다."
ko.R: 그런데 아람 군인 하나가 아무나 겨누지 않고 활을 쏘았다. 그 화살이 이스라엘 왕의 갑옷 이음새를 맞혔다. 왕이 자기 병거를 모는 병사에게 말했다. "병거를 돌려 나를 싸움터에서 데리고 나가거라! 내가 다쳤다."

pt.L: E um homem puxou o arco ao acaso e atingiu o rei de Israel entre as juntas da armadura e a couraça. E ele disse ao condutor do seu carro: "Vire a sua mão e tire-me do acampamento, porque estou ferido."
pt.B: Mas um homem puxou o arco ao acaso e atingiu o rei de Israel entre as juntas da sua armadura de escamas e a couraça. O rei disse ao condutor do seu carro: "Dê a volta e tire-me da batalha, porque estou ferido."
pt.R: Mas um soldado arameu atirou uma flecha sem mirar em ninguém. A flecha atingiu o rei de Israel bem onde as partes da armadura se juntavam. O rei disse ao condutor do seu carro: "Dê a volta e tire-me da luta! Estou ferido."

decisions.choice: in his innocence: at random, without aiming at the king
decisions.reason: The word means simplicity or innocence. The archer shot without a particular target and with no idea who he hit. What the Aramean commanders failed to do with their orders, one unaimed arrow did, as Micaiah had said.

decisions.choice: between the scales and the armor: at a gap where pieces of armor met
alternatives: between the joints and the coat of mail
between the lower armor and the breastplate
decisions.reason: The two words are rare and their exact meaning is not certain. The first, from a root meaning "to cling, to join", may name the joints or the small overlapping plates of scale armor; the second names a coat of mail or breastplate. The arrow struck at a weak point where they met, perhaps under the arm or at the waist.

decisions.choice: turn your hand: turn the chariot around
decisions.reason: The driver holds the reins in his hand; to turn his hand is to turn the horses.

decisions.choice: the camp: the army, the battle lines
decisions.reason: Here "camp" means the army drawn up in battle, so to be taken out of it is to leave the fighting.

decisions.choice: an Aramean soldier
decisions.reason: Readable says that the archer was one of the enemy, which the context makes plain.

decisions.choice: joints ... breastplate / where his armor joined together
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced name the two parts of the armor; Readable gives the sense that matters, a gap in the armor (m2).

decisions.choice: "Tourne ta main" (L); "Fais demi-tour" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the driver’s hand on the reins; Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: deraya; kifuko cha kifua
decisions.reason: The armour is "deraya" (a coat of mail) and the breastplate "kifuko cha kifua"; Readable says only where the pieces met, as the English does.

source.text: וַתַּעֲלֶ֤ה הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְהַמֶּ֗לֶךְ הָיָ֧ה מָעֳמָ֛ד בַּמֶּרְכָּבָ֖ה נֹ֣כַח אֲרָ֑ם וַיָּ֣מָת בָּעֶ֔רֶב וַיִּ֥צֶק דַּֽם־הַמַּכָּ֖ה אֶל־חֵ֥יק הָרָֽכֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And went up the battle on that day, and the king was propped up in the chariot opposite Aram; and he died in the evening, and poured out [the] blood of the wound into [the] bottom of the chariot.

en.L: And the battle went up on that day, and the king was propped up in the chariot facing Aram; and he died in the evening, and the blood of the wound poured out into the bottom of the chariot.
en.B: All that day the battle grew fiercer, and the king was held upright in his chariot facing the Arameans. He died at evening, and blood from the wound flowed down into the floor of the chariot.
en.R: The battle grew worse all that day. The king stayed propped up in his chariot, facing the Arameans. In the evening he died. The blood from his wound had run down onto the floor of the chariot.

es.L: Y la batalla arreció aquel día, y el rey se mantuvo de pie en el carro frente a Aram; y murió al atardecer, y la sangre de la herida corría hasta el fondo del carro.
es.B: Durante todo aquel día la batalla se hizo más intensa, y al rey lo sostuvieron de pie en su carro frente a los arameos. Murió al atardecer, y la sangre de la herida corrió hasta el piso del carro.
es.R: La batalla empeoró durante todo aquel día. Al rey lo mantuvieron sostenido en su carro, frente a los arameos. Al atardecer murió. La sangre de su herida había corrido hasta el piso del carro.

fr.L: Et la bataille monta ce jour-là, et le roi fut maintenu debout dans le char face à Aram ; et il mourut le soir, et le sang de la blessure coula au fond du char.
fr.B: La bataille devint de plus en plus violente ce jour-là, et le roi fut maintenu debout dans son char face aux Araméens. Il mourut le soir, et le sang de sa blessure coula au fond du char.
fr.R: La bataille est devenue de plus en plus terrible pendant toute la journée. Le roi est resté debout dans son char, soutenu face aux Araméens. Le soir, il est mort. Le sang de sa blessure avait coulé au fond du char.

sw.L: Vita vikapanda siku ile, naye mfalme akategemezwa garini akiwaelekea Aramu; akafa jioni, na damu ya jeraha ikamwagika chini ya gari.
sw.B: Siku ile yote vita vikazidi kuwa vikali, naye mfalme akashikiliwa wima garini akiwaelekea Waaramu. Akafa jioni, na damu ya jeraha lake ikatiririka sakafuni mwa gari.
sw.R: Vita vikazidi kuwa vibaya siku ile yote. Mfalme akabaki ameegemezwa garini mwake, akiwaelekea Waaramu. Jioni akafa. Damu ya jeraha lake ilikuwa imetiririka mpaka sakafuni mwa gari.

vi.L: Ngày hôm ấy trận chiến dâng cao, và vua được dựng đứng trong xe đối diện quân A-ram; đến chiều thì vua chết, và máu từ vết thương chảy xuống lòng xe.
vi.B: Suốt ngày hôm ấy trận chiến càng thêm ác liệt, và vua được đỡ đứng trong xe, mặt hướng về quân A-ram. Đến chiều vua chết, và máu từ vết thương chảy xuống sàn xe.
vi.R: Suốt ngày hôm ấy trận chiến càng lúc càng dữ dội. Vua vẫn được đỡ đứng trong xe, mặt hướng về quân A-ram. Đến chiều thì vua chết. Máu từ vết thương đã chảy xuống sàn xe.

ko.L: 그리고 그날 싸움이 거세어졌고, 왕은 아람을 마주하여 병거 안에 붙들려 서 있었다. 그리고 그가 저녁에 죽었고, 상처의 피가 병거 바닥에 흘러내렸다.
ko.B: 그날 싸움은 종일 치열해졌고, 왕은 아람 군대를 마주한 채 병거 안에 붙들려 서 있었다. 그는 저녁에 죽었는데, 상처에서 흘러나온 피가 병거 바닥에 고였다.
ko.R: 그날 하루 종일 싸움은 점점 더 심해졌다. 왕은 아람 군대를 바라보며 병거 안에 부축을 받고 서 있었다. 그리고 저녁에 죽었다. 그의 상처에서 흐른 피가 병거 바닥에 흥건했다.

pt.L: E a batalha subiu naquele dia, e o rei foi mantido de pé no carro diante de Arã; e ele morreu à tarde, e o sangue da ferida escorreu para o fundo do carro.
pt.B: A batalha foi ficando mais violenta durante todo aquele dia, e o rei foi mantido de pé no seu carro, de frente para os arameus. Ele morreu ao entardecer, e o sangue da ferida escorreu para o piso do carro.
pt.R: A batalha foi piorando durante todo aquele dia. O rei ficou apoiado de pé no seu carro, de frente para os arameus. À tarde ele morreu. O sangue da sua ferida tinha escorrido para o piso do carro.

decisions.choice: the battle went up: the battle rose, grew fierce
decisions.reason: The fighting increased in intensity through the day.

decisions.choice: propped up in the chariot facing Aram: kept upright so the troops would not lose heart
decisions.reason: Instead of leaving the field as he had ordered (verse 34), the king was held upright in his chariot, facing the enemy, perhaps so that his army would not see that he was wounded. He bled to death through the day.

decisions.choice: the blood of the wound: preparing for verse 38
decisions.reason: The detail of the blood in the chariot leads to verse 38, where the dogs lick up Ahab's blood as Yahweh had said (21:19).

decisions.choice: grew fierce / grew worse
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "went up" means here (m1).

source.text: וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ר הָרִנָּה֙ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה כְּבֹ֥א הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ לֵאמֹ֑ר אִ֥ישׁ אֶל־עִיר֖וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶל־אַרְצֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And passed the cry through the camp at the going of the sun, saying, [each] man to his city, and [each] man to his land.

en.L: And the cry passed through the camp as the sun went down, saying, "Each man to his city, and each man to his land!"
en.B: As the sun was setting, a shout went through the army: "Every man to his town! Every man to his own land!"
en.R: As the sun went down, the order was shouted all through the army: "Everyone go home to your own town and your own land!"

es.L: Y a la puesta del sol pasó un grito por el campamento, que decía: «¡Cada uno a su ciudad, y cada uno a su tierra!».
es.B: Al ponerse el sol, un grito recorrió el ejército: «¡Cada uno a su ciudad! ¡Cada uno a su tierra!».
es.R: Cuando se puso el sol, la orden se gritó por todo el ejército: «¡Que cada uno vuelva a su ciudad y a su tierra!».

fr.L: Et le cri passa dans le camp au coucher du soleil, en disant : « Chacun à sa ville, et chacun à son pays ! »
fr.B: Au coucher du soleil, un cri parcourut l’armée : « Chacun dans sa ville ! Chacun dans son pays ! »
fr.R: Quand le soleil s’est couché, on a crié l’ordre dans toute l’armée : « Que chacun rentre chez lui, dans sa ville et dans son pays ! »

sw.L: Kelele ikapita katika kambi jua lilipokuwa likizama, ikisema, "Kila mtu mjini kwake, na kila mtu nchini kwake!"
sw.B: Jua lilipokuwa likizama, sauti ikapazwa katika jeshi lote: "Kila mtu aende mjini kwake! Kila mtu aende nchini kwake!"
sw.R: Jua lilipozama, amri ikatangazwa kwa sauti katika jeshi lote: "Kila mtu arudi nyumbani katika mji wake na nchi yake!"

vi.L: Lúc mặt trời lặn, có tiếng hô truyền khắp trại quân rằng: "Mỗi người về thành mình, mỗi người về xứ mình!"
vi.B: Khi mặt trời sắp lặn, có tiếng hô vang khắp quân đội: "Ai nấy hãy về thành mình! Ai nấy hãy về xứ mình!"
vi.R: Khi mặt trời lặn, có lệnh hô lên khắp quân đội: "Mọi người hãy về nhà, về thành và về xứ của mình!"

ko.L: 그리고 해가 질 무렵 진 안에 외치는 소리가 지나갔다. "각자 자기 성읍으로, 각자 자기 땅으로!"
ko.B: 해가 질 무렵 진영 안에 이런 외침이 퍼졌다. "모두 자기 성읍으로! 모두 자기 땅으로 돌아가라!"
ko.R: 해가 질 무렵 온 군대에 이런 명령이 퍼졌다. "모두 자기 성읍, 자기 땅으로 돌아가라!"

pt.L: E o grito passou pelo acampamento ao pôr do sol, dizendo: "Cada um para a sua cidade, e cada um para a sua terra!"
pt.B: Quando o sol se punha, um grito correu pelo exército: "Cada um para a sua cidade! Cada um para a sua terra!"
pt.R: Quando o sol se pôs, a ordem foi gritada por todo o exército: "Todos para casa, para a sua cidade e para a sua terra!"

decisions.choice: each man to his city: the army disbanded
decisions.reason: The call sends every soldier home: with the king dead, the campaign is over. It fulfills Micaiah's vision of the flock without a shepherd, each returning home in peace (verse 17).

decisions.choice: the cry: a ringing shout
decisions.reason: The word is used of a loud cry, of joy or of alarm. Here it is the order shouted through the ranks.

decisions.choice: the order was shouted
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the cry was an order to the troops (m2).

source.text: וַיָּ֣מָת הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיָּב֖וֹא שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ אֶת־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּשֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And died the king, and he came [to] Samaria, and they buried the king in Samaria.

en.L: And the king died, and he came [to] Samaria, and they buried the king in Samaria.
en.B: So the king died. He was brought to Samaria, and they buried him there.
en.R: So the king died. His body was brought back to Samaria, and he was buried there.

es.L: Y murió el rey, y llegó [a] Samaria, y sepultaron al rey en Samaria.
es.B: Así murió el rey. Lo llevaron a Samaria, y allí lo sepultaron.
es.R: Así murió el rey. Su cuerpo fue llevado de vuelta a Samaria, y allí fue sepultado.

fr.L: Et le roi mourut, et il vint [à] Samarie, et on enterra le roi à Samarie.
fr.B: Ainsi mourut le roi. On le ramena à Samarie, et on l’y enterra.
fr.R: Le roi est donc mort. On a ramené son corps à Samarie, et on l’a enterré là.

sw.L: Mfalme akafa, akaletwa Samaria, wakamzika mfalme huko Samaria.
sw.B: Basi mfalme akafa. Akaletwa Samaria, wakamzika huko.
sw.R: Basi mfalme akafa. Mwili wake ukaletwa Samaria, akazikwa huko.

vi.L: Vua chết, và được đem về Sa-ma-ri; người ta chôn vua tại Sa-ma-ri.
vi.B: Vậy vua chết. Vua được đưa về Sa-ma-ri, và người ta chôn vua tại đó.
vi.R: Vậy vua chết. Thi hài vua được đưa về Sa-ma-ri và được chôn tại đó.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 죽었고, 그가 사마리아로 왔다. 그리고 그들이 왕을 사마리아에 묻었다.
ko.B: 이렇게 왕은 죽었다. 그의 시신은 사마리아로 옮겨졌고, 사람들은 그를 거기에 묻었다.
ko.R: 이렇게 왕은 죽었다. 그의 시신은 사마리아로 옮겨졌고, 그는 거기에 묻혔다.

pt.L: E o rei morreu, e veio [a] Samaria, e sepultaram o rei em Samaria.
pt.B: Assim o rei morreu. Ele foi levado para Samaria, e ali o sepultaram.
pt.R: Assim o rei morreu. O seu corpo foi levado de volta para Samaria, e ele foi sepultado lá.

decisions.choice: he came to Samaria: his body was brought to Samaria
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says simply "he came". The dead king was carried back to his capital for burial. Some ancient translations read "they came".

decisions.choice: buried in Samaria: in the royal city his father built
decisions.reason: Omri, Ahab's father, had built Samaria and was buried there (16:24, 28).

decisions.choice: was brought / His body was brought
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "he came" means here (m1).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁטֹ֨ף אֶת־הָרֶ֜כֶב עַ֣ל׀בְּרֵכַ֣ת שֹׁמְר֗וֹן וַיָּלֹ֤קּוּ הַכְּלָבִים֙ אֶת־דָּמ֔וֹ וְהַזֹּנ֖וֹת רָחָ֑צוּ כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he washed the chariot by [the] pool of Samaria, and licked up the dogs his blood, and the prostitutes bathed, according to [the] word of Yahweh which he had spoken.

en.L: And one washed the chariot at the pool of Samaria, and the dogs licked up his blood, and the prostitutes bathed, according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had spoken.
en.B: When they washed the chariot at the pool of Samaria, dogs licked up his blood, and the prostitutes bathed there, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said.
en.R: Someone washed out the chariot at the pool in Samaria. Dogs licked up the king's blood, and prostitutes washed themselves in the pool. It happened just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said it would.

es.L: Y lavaron el carro junto al estanque de Samaria, y los perros lamieron su sangre, y las prostitutas se bañaron [allí], conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había hablado.
es.B: Cuando lavaron el carro junto al estanque de Samaria, los perros lamieron su sangre, y las prostitutas se bañaron allí, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había dicho.
es.R: Alguien lavó el carro en el estanque de Samaria. Los perros lamieron la sangre del rey, y las prostitutas se bañaron en el estanque. Sucedió tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho que sucedería.

fr.L: Et on lava le char à l’étang de Samarie, et les chiens léchèrent son sang, et les prostituées s’y baignèrent, selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait dite.
fr.B: Quand on lava le char à l’étang de Samarie, les chiens léchèrent son sang, et les prostituées s’y baignèrent, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait dit.
fr.R: On a lavé le char à l’étang de Samarie. Des chiens ont léché le sang du roi, et des prostituées se sont lavées dans l’étang. C’est arrivé exactement comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait annoncé.

sw.L: Mtu akaliosha gari kwenye bwawa la Samaria, na mbwa wakairamba damu yake, na makahaba wakaoga, sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilolinena.
sw.B: Walipoliosha gari kwenye bwawa la Samaria, mbwa wakairamba damu yake, na makahaba wakaoga huko, sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mtu mmoja akaliosha gari kwenye bwawa la Samaria. Mbwa wakairamba damu ya mfalme, na makahaba wakaoga katika bwawa hilo. Ilitokea kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema itakuwa.

vi.L: Người ta rửa xe bên hồ Sa-ma-ri; chó liếm máu vua, và các kỹ nữ tắm tại đó, đúng theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán.
vi.B: Khi người ta rửa xe bên hồ Sa-ma-ri, chó liếm máu vua, và các kỹ nữ tắm tại đó, đúng như lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.R: Có người rửa chiếc xe ở hồ nước tại Sa-ma-ri. Chó đến liếm máu vua, và các kỹ nữ tắm trong hồ ấy. Việc ấy xảy ra đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.

ko.L: 그리고 사람이 사마리아 못에서 병거를 씻었는데, 개들이 그의 피를 핥았고 창녀들이 [거기서] 목욕했다. 그분께서 하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀대로였다.
ko.B: 사람들이 사마리아 못에서 그 병거를 씻을 때 개들이 그의 피를 핥았고, 창녀들이 거기서 목욕했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀대로였다.
ko.R: 어떤 사람이 사마리아 못에서 그 병거를 씻었다. 그러자 개들이 왕의 피를 핥았고, 창녀들이 그 못에서 몸을 씻었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 그대로 일어났다.

pt.L: E lavaram o carro junto ao açude de Samaria, e os cães lamberam o seu sangue, e as prostitutas se banharam, conforme a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha falado.
pt.B: Quando lavaram o carro no açude de Samaria, os cães lamberam o seu sangue, e as prostitutas se banharam ali, exatamente como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito.
pt.R: Alguém lavou o carro no açude de Samaria. Os cães lamberam o sangue do rei, e as prostitutas tomaram banho no açude. Aconteceu exatamente como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito.

decisions.choice: the prostitutes bathed: prostitutes washed in the pool where his blood was washed out
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "and the prostitutes bathed". The point seems to be the shame of the king's end: his blood went to dogs and into water used by prostitutes. Some ancient readers took the words differently, as "they washed the armor" or "they washed his weapons", reading the word for prostitutes as a word for arms, but the Hebrew word is the ordinary word for prostitutes. Why the prostitutes are mentioned is not explained.

decisions.choice: according to the word of Yahweh: the fulfillment of 21:19
decisions.reason: After the murder of Naboth, Elijah told Ahab, "In the place where the dogs licked the blood of Naboth, the dogs will lick your blood, yes, yours" (21:19). Naboth was killed at Jezreel (21:1, 13), and Ahab's blood is licked up at Samaria. Because Ahab humbled himself, Yahweh delayed part of the judgment until his son's days (21:29); the rest is completed when Ahab's son Joram is killed and thrown on Naboth's land (2 Kings 9:25-26). The writer sees Ahab's death as the word of Yahweh coming true, as Micaiah also said (verses 17, 28).

decisions.choice: he washed: someone washed
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject; it means "the chariot was washed".

decisions.choice: the king's blood
decisions.reason: Readable names whose blood it was, since "his" could be read as the chariot driver's.

decisions.choice: os cães lamberam o seu sangue
alternatives: os cães lamberam o teu sangue
decisions.reason: The fulfilment (m2) repeats the verb of 21:19 in Portuguese, "lamber", so that the reader can lay the word beside the event; there the LORD said "o teu sangue" to Ahab, here the narrator says "o seu sangue". Literal says "lavaram" for the verb without a named subject (m3), the Portuguese impersonal plural.

source.text: וְיֶתֶר֩ דִּבְרֵ֨י אַחְאָ֜ב וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֗ה וּבֵ֤ית הַשֵּׁן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֔ה וְכָל־הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּנָ֑ה הֲלֽוֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Ahab and all that he did, and [the] house of the ivory which he built, and all the cities which he built, are not they written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of the kings of Israel?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Ahab, and all that he did, and the house of ivory that he built, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Ahab, all that he did, the ivory palace he built and all the cities he built, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
en.R: Everything else Ahab did is written in the history of the kings of Israel. It tells about the palace he built and decorated with ivory, and all the cities he built.

es.L: Y el resto de los hechos de Acab, y todo lo que hizo, y la casa de marfil que edificó, y todas las ciudades que edificó, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Acab, todo lo que hizo, el palacio de marfil que edificó y todas las ciudades que edificó, están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Acab está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Israel. Allí se habla del palacio que construyó y decoró con marfil, y de todas las ciudades que construyó.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes d’Achab, et tout ce qu’il a fait, et la maison d’ivoire qu’il a bâtie, et toutes les villes qu’il a bâties, n’est-ce pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes d’Achab, tout ce qu’il a fait, le palais d’ivoire et toutes les villes qu’il a bâtis, est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.
fr.R: Tout ce qu’Achab a fait d’autre a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël. On y parle du palais qu’il a construit et décoré d’ivoire, et de toutes les villes qu’il a construites.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Ahabu, na yote aliyoyafanya, na nyumba ya pembe aliyoijenga, na miji yote aliyoijenga, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Israeli?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Ahabu, yote aliyoyafanya, jumba la pembe za ndovu alilolijenga na miji yote aliyoijenga, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyofanya Ahabu yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Israeli. Inaeleza habari za jumba alilojenga na kulipamba kwa pembe za ndovu, na miji yote aliyoijenga.

vi.L: Các việc khác của A-háp, mọi điều ông đã làm, cung điện bằng ngà ông đã xây và mọi thành ông đã xây, chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của A-háp, mọi điều vua đã làm, cung điện bằng ngà vua đã xây và mọi thành vua đã xây, đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác A-háp đã làm đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên. Sách ấy kể về cung điện vua đã xây và trang trí bằng ngà, cùng mọi thành vua đã xây.

ko.L: 그리고 아합의 나머지 일들과 그가 행한 모든 것과 그가 지은 상아 집과 그가 건축한 모든 성읍은 이스라엘 왕들의 날들의 일들을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?
ko.B: 아합의 나머지 행적과 그가 한 모든 일과, 그가 지은 상아 궁과 그가 세운 모든 성읍은 이스라엘 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 아합이 한 다른 모든 일은 이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다. 그 책에는 그가 상아로 꾸며 지은 궁과 그가 세운 모든 성읍에 대한 이야기도 있다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Acabe, e tudo o que ele fez, e a casa de marfim que ele construiu, e todas as cidades que ele construiu, não estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel?
pt.B: Os demais atos de Acabe, tudo o que ele fez, o palácio de marfim que construiu e todas as cidades que construiu estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Acabe fez está escrito na história dos reis de Israel. Ela conta sobre o palácio que ele construiu e enfeitou com marfim, e sobre todas as cidades que ele construiu.

decisions.choice: the house of ivory: a palace decorated with carved ivory
decisions.reason: The house was not made of ivory but adorned with ivory panels and inlays on its walls and furniture. Many carved ivory pieces have been found in the ruins of the royal buildings at Samaria. Amos later condemned the "houses of ivory" of Israel's rich (Amos 3:15; 6:4).

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel: a royal record now lost
decisions.reason: As at 14:19 and 16:5, the writer sends readers to a fuller record of the kings of Israel, which has not survived.

decisions.choice: are they not written ...?: a question that means "they are written"
decisions.reason: The standard closing formula for a reign in Kings.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel / the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel / the history of the kings of Israel
decisions.reason: The source formula has one wording at each level throughout Kings. Balanced and Readable turn the question into a statement (m3).

decisions.choice: ivory palace / palace ... decorated with ivory
decisions.reason: "House" here is a royal palace; Readable says how the ivory was used (m1).

decisions.choice: o Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Israel (L, B); a história dos reis de Israel (R)
alternatives: o livro dos acontecimentos dos dias dos reis
decisions.reason: The source formula (m2, m3) keeps one wording at each level for the whole book: "Crônicas", the Portuguese name for a record of "the matters of the days", as in the book of Chronicles; the question is kept at Literal, and Balanced and Readable state it as a fact, as the English does. Readable says "a história dos reis", as the English Readable.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֥ב אַחְאָ֖ב עִם־אֲבֹתָ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֲחַזְיָ֥הוּ בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Ahab with his fathers, and reigned Ahaziah his son in his place.

en.L: And Ahab lay down with his fathers, and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
en.B: So Ahab rested with his ancestors, and his son Ahaziah became king in his place.
en.R: So Ahab died, and his son Ahaziah became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Acab con sus padres, y reinó en su lugar Ocozías su hijo.
es.B: Así Acab descansó con sus antepasados, y su hijo Ocozías reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Así Acab murió, y su hijo Ocozías lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Achab se coucha avec ses pères, et Achazia son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Achab reposa donc avec ses ancêtres, et Achazia son fils régna à sa place.
fr.R: Achab est donc mort, et son fils Achazia est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Ahabu akalala pamoja na baba zake, na Ahazia mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Basi Ahabu akapumzika pamoja na babu zake, na mwanawe Ahazia akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Basi Ahabu akafa, na mwanawe Ahazia akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: A-háp nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, và A-cha-xia con trai ông trị vì thay ông.
vi.B: Vậy A-háp an giấc cùng tổ tiên, và A-cha-xia con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Vậy A-háp qua đời, và A-cha-xia con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 아합이 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 그의 아들 아하시야가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 아합은 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 그의 아들 아하시야가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 아합은 죽었고, 그의 아들 아하시야가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Acabe descansou com os seus pais, e Acazias, o seu filho, reinou no seu lugar.
pt.B: Assim Acabe descansou com os seus antepassados, e o seu filho Acazias se tornou rei no seu lugar.
pt.R: Assim Acabe morreu e foi descansar com os seus antepassados, e o seu filho Acazias se tornou rei depois dele.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: This is the death formula of Kings (2:10; 16:6, 28). It is used here even though Ahab died in battle, so it does not mean a peaceful death; it says only that he joined his ancestors in death.

decisions.choice: Ahaziah: Ahab's son, king of Israel
decisions.reason: Not to be confused with Ahaziah son of Jehoram, a later king of Judah (2 Kings 8:24-26). His reign is introduced at verse 52.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula is worded the same way at each level throughout Kings.

decisions.choice: "Ocozías"
decisions.reason: The Kings and Chronicles terms table's form for Ahaziah.

decisions.choice: "Achazia"
decisions.reason: The form of the terms note, used for both kings of that name.

decisions.choice: "A-cha-xia"
decisions.reason: The terms note's form of Ahaziah, the same in 2 Kings.

decisions.choice: descansou com os seus pais (L); com os seus antepassados (B); morreu e foi descansar com os seus antepassados (R); Acazias
decisions.reason: The death formula as set for the whole book at 2:10, at each level, although Ahab died in battle (m1); Readable keeps the words of 2:10 where the English Readable says only "died", so that the formula reads the same for every king. "Acazias" as set for Kings.

source.text: וִיהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ בֶּן־אָסָ֔א מָלַ֖ךְ עַל־יְהוּדָ֑ה בִּשְׁנַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֔ע לְאַחְאָ֖ב מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king over Judah in [the] year four of Ahab king of Israel.

en.L: And Jehoshaphat son of Asa reigned over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
en.B: In the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king over Judah.
en.R: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah. It was the fourth year that Ahab had been king of Israel.

es.L: Y Josafat hijo de Asá comenzó a reinar sobre Judá en el año cuarto de Acab rey de Israel.
es.B: En el cuarto año de Acab rey de Israel, Josafat hijo de Asá comenzó a reinar sobre Judá.
es.R: Josafat hijo de Asá llegó a ser rey de Judá. Era el cuarto año del reinado de Acab en Israel.

fr.L: Et Josaphat fils d’Asa régna sur Juda en la quatrième année d’Achab, roi d’Israël.
fr.B: La quatrième année du règne d’Achab, roi d’Israël, Josaphat, fils d’Asa, devint roi de Juda.
fr.R: Josaphat, fils d’Asa, est devenu roi de Juda. C’était la quatrième année du règne d’Achab sur Israël.

sw.L: Yehoshafati mwana wa Asa akatawala juu ya Yuda katika mwaka wa nne wa Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa nne wa Ahabu mfalme wa Israeli, Yehoshafati mwana wa Asa alianza kutawala juu ya Yuda.
sw.R: Yehoshafati mwana wa Asa alianza kutawala kama mfalme wa Yuda. Ulikuwa mwaka wa nne tangu Ahabu alipoanza kutawala Israeli.

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát con trai A-sa trị vì trên Giu-đa vào năm thứ tư đời A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Năm thứ tư đời A-háp vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, Giô-sa-phát con trai A-sa lên làm vua Giu-đa.
vi.R: Giô-sa-phát con trai A-sa lên làm vua Giu-đa. Lúc ấy là năm thứ tư A-háp làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕 아합 제4년에 아사의 아들 여호사밧이 유다 위에 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕 아합이 다스린 지 4년째 되는 해에 아사의 아들 여호사밧이 유다의 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 아사의 아들 여호사밧이 유다의 왕이 되었다. 그때는 아합이 이스라엘의 왕이 된 지 4년째 되는 해였다.

pt.L: E Josafá, filho de Asa, começou a reinar sobre Judá no quarto ano de Acabe, rei de Israel.
pt.B: No quarto ano de Acabe, rei de Israel, Josafá, filho de Asa, começou a reinar sobre Judá.
pt.R: Josafá, filho de Asa, se tornou rei de Judá. Era o quarto ano do reinado de Acabe em Israel.

decisions.choice: the reign of Jehoshaphat: the account returns to Judah
decisions.reason: Kings now gives the formal account of Jehoshaphat's reign, which began years before the battle of this chapter (15:24). Further events of his reign are told in 2 Kings 3 and in 2 Chronicles 17-20.

decisions.choice: became king: began to reign
decisions.reason: With a date, the verb marks the start of the reign, as in the accession formula of 15:1, 9.

decisions.choice: the date first / two sentences
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the date first, as the accession formula does throughout Kings; Readable splits it into two sentences, as in 15:1.

decisions.choice: No quarto ano de Acabe, rei de Israel, Josafá ... começou a reinar (B)
decisions.reason: The synchronism of the kings keeps one wording at each level for the whole book: "começou a reinar", with the date first at Balanced as the English, and two short sentences at Readable.

source.text: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֗ט בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְחָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ עֲזוּבָ֖ה בַּת־שִׁלְחִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Jehoshaphat [was] a son of thirty and five year[s] when he became king, and twenty and five year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem; and [the] name of his mother [was] Azubah daughter of Shilhi.

en.L: Jehoshaphat [was] thirty-five years old when he became king, and twenty-five years he reigned in Jerusalem, and the name of his mother [was] Azubah daughter of Shilhi.
en.B: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king. He reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years, and his mother's name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.
en.R: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for twenty-five years. His mother was Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi.

es.L: Josafat [era] de treinta y cinco años cuando comenzó a reinar, y veinticinco años reinó en Jerusalén, y el nombre de su madre [era] Azuba hija de Silhi.
es.B: Josafat tenía treinta y cinco años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó veinticinco años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Azuba hija de Silhi.
es.R: Josafat tenía treinta y cinco años cuando comenzó a reinar. Reinó veinticinco años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Azuba, la hija de Silhi.

fr.L: Josaphat [était] fils de trente-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna vingt-cinq ans à Jérusalem ; et le nom de sa mère [était] Azouba fille de Shilhi.
fr.B: Josaphat avait trente-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna vingt-cinq ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Azouba, fille de Shilhi.
fr.R: Josaphat avait trente-cinq ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné vingt-cinq ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Azouba ; c’était la fille de Shilhi.

sw.L: Yehoshafati [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka thelathini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka ishirini na mitano huko Yerusalemu. Na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Azuba binti Shilhi.
sw.B: Yehoshafati alikuwa na umri wa miaka thelathini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka ishirini na mitano huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Azuba binti Shilhi.
sw.R: Yehoshafati alikuwa na umri wa miaka thelathini na mitano alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka ishirini na mitano. Mama yake aliitwa Azuba binti Shilhi.

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát được ba mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua, và ông trị vì hai mươi lăm năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tên mẹ ông [là] A-xu-ba con gái Si-hi.
vi.B: Giô-sa-phát được ba mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì hai mươi lăm năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là A-xu-ba, con gái Si-hi.
vi.R: Giô-sa-phát được ba mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua. Vua trị vì tại Giê-ru-sa-lem hai mươi lăm năm. Mẹ vua tên là A-xu-ba, con gái Si-hi.

ko.L: 여호사밧은 왕이 될 때 35세였고, 예루살렘에서 25년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 실히의 딸 아수바였다.
ko.B: 여호사밧은 35세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 25년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 실히의 딸 아수바였다.
ko.R: 여호사밧은 35세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 25년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 실히의 딸 아수바였다.

pt.L: Josafá [tinha] trinta e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou vinte e cinco anos em Jerusalém; e o nome da sua mãe [era] Azuba, filha de Sili.
pt.B: Josafá tinha trinta e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou vinte e cinco anos em Jerusalém. A sua mãe se chamava Azuba, filha de Sili.
pt.R: Josafá tinha trinta e cinco anos quando se tornou rei. Ele governou em Jerusalém durante vinte e cinco anos. A sua mãe era Azuba, filha de Sili.

decisions.choice: a son of thirty-five years: thirty-five years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being "a son of" so many years.

decisions.choice: the name of his mother: the queen mother
decisions.reason: For the kings of Judah, Kings names each king's mother (15:2, 10). The king's mother held an honored position at court (2:19; 15:13).

decisions.choice: thirty-five years old
decisions.reason: Every level gives the age in the normal English way (m1).

decisions.choice: "Azuba hija de Silhi"
decisions.reason: Usual Spanish forms.

decisions.choice: "Azouba fille de Shilhi"
decisions.reason: French spelling with ou for the Hebrew u, as Tserouya and Houshaï in Samuel.

decisions.choice: names: "A-xu-ba", "Si-hi"
decisions.reason: Usual Protestant forms of Azubah and Shilhi, kept the same in 2 Chronicles 20:31.

decisions.choice: Josafá [tinha] trinta e cinco anos quando começou a reinar (L); A sua mãe se chamava (B)
alternatives: era filho de trinta e cinco anos
decisions.reason: The accession formula as 2 Samuel 2:10 and 5:4 have it in Portuguese, one wording at each level for the whole book: Portuguese gives an age with "ter" (m1), bracketed at Literal; "Azuba" and "Sili" are the usual Brazilian forms of the names.

source.text: וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּכָל־דֶּ֛רֶךְ אָסָ֥א אָבִ֖יו לֹא־סָ֣ר מִמֶּ֑נּוּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he walked in all [the] way of Asa his father; not he turned aside from it, doing the right in [the] eyes of Yahweh.

en.L: And he walked in all the way of Asa his father; he did not turn aside from it, doing the right in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: He followed all the ways of his father Asa and did not turn aside from them, doing what was right in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: He lived the way his father Asa had lived and never turned away from it. He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was right.

es.L: Y anduvo en todo el camino de Asá su padre; no se apartó de él, haciendo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Siguió en todo el camino de su padre Asá y no se apartó de él, haciendo lo recto a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Vivió como había vivido su padre Asá y nunca se apartó de ese camino. Hizo lo que agrada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et il marcha dans toute la voie d’Asa son père ; il ne s’en détourna pas, faisant ce qui est droit aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Il suivit en tout la voie de son père Asa et ne s’en détourna pas, faisant ce qui est juste aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Il a vécu comme son père Asa et ne s’en est jamais écarté. Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare bon.

sw.L: Akaenda katika njia yote ya Asa baba yake; hakugeuka kando kutoka kwayo, akifanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Alifuata njia zote za Asa baba yake, wala hakugeuka kando kutoka kwazo, akafanya yaliyo sawa machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Aliishi kama Asa baba yake alivyoishi, wala hakuiacha njia hiyo kamwe. Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mema.

vi.L: Ông đi trong mọi đường lối của A-sa cha mình, không lìa bỏ, làm điều ngay thẳng trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vua đi theo mọi đường lối của A-sa cha mình, không hề lìa bỏ, làm điều ngay thẳng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Vua sống như A-sa cha mình đã sống và không bao giờ bỏ đường lối ấy. Vua làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là phải.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그의 아버지 아사의 모든 길로 걸었고, 거기에서 벗어나지 않고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 올바른 일을 했다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 아버지 아사가 걸어간 모든 길을 따라갔고, 그 길에서 벗어나지 않고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 올바른 일을 했다.
ko.R: 그는 그의 아버지 아사가 살던 대로 살았고, 그 길에서 한 번도 벗어나지 않았다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 옳다고 하신 일을 했다.

pt.L: E ele andou em todo o caminho de Asa, o seu pai; não se desviou dele, fazendo o que [é] reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Ele seguiu em tudo os caminhos do seu pai Asa e não se desviou deles, fazendo o que era reto aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Ele viveu como o seu pai Asa tinha vivido e nunca se afastou desse caminho. Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz que é certo.

decisions.choice: walked in the way of Asa: lived as Asa had lived
decisions.reason: To walk in someone's way is to follow his example. Asa had done what was right in Yahweh's eyes (15:11).

decisions.choice: doing the right in the eyes of Yahweh: the verdict on a good king
decisions.reason: This is the verdict formula of Kings for a king who served Yahweh (15:11).

decisions.choice: did the right in [the] eyes of / did what was right in the sight of / did what the LORD said was right
decisions.reason: The verdict formula has one wording at each level throughout these books.

decisions.choice: o que [é] reto aos olhos do SENHOR (L); o que era reto aos olhos do SENHOR (B); o que o SENHOR diz que é certo (R)
decisions.reason: The verdict formula (m2) keeps one wording at each level for the whole book, matching "o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR" (verse 53); Readable follows the English "what the LORD said was right".

source.text: אַ֥ךְ הַבָּמ֖וֹת לֹֽא־סָ֑רוּ ע֥וֹד הָעָ֛ם מְזַבְּחִ֥ים וּֽמְקַטְּרִ֖ים בַּבָּמֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Only the high places were not removed; still the people [were] sacrificing and making smoke at the high places.

en.L: Only the high places were not removed; the people were still sacrificing and burning incense at the high places.
en.B: However, the high places were not removed; the people still offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places.
en.R: But the hilltop shrines were not removed. The people still offered sacrifices and burned incense at the hilltop shrines.

es.L: Solo que los lugares altos no fueron quitados; el pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba incienso en los lugares altos.
es.B: Sin embargo, los lugares altos no fueron quitados; el pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba incienso en los lugares altos.
es.R: Pero los santuarios sobre las colinas no fueron quitados. El pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba incienso en los santuarios sobre las colinas.

fr.L: Seulement, les hauts lieux ne furent pas supprimés ; le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et brûlait de l’encens sur les hauts lieux.
fr.B: Cependant, les hauts lieux ne disparurent pas ; le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et brûlait de l’encens sur les hauts lieux.
fr.R: Mais les sanctuaires sur les collines n’ont pas été supprimés. Le peuple offrait encore des sacrifices et brûlait de l’encens dans ces sanctuaires sur les collines.

sw.L: Ila mahali pa juu hapakuondolewa; watu waliendelea kutoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba mahali pa juu.
sw.B: Hata hivyo, mahali pa juu hapakuondolewa; watu waliendelea kutoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba mahali pa juu.
sw.R: Lakini patakatifu pa kilimani hapakuondolewa. Watu waliendelea kutoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba katika patakatifu pa kilimani.

vi.L: Chỉ có các nơi cao là không bị dẹp bỏ; dân chúng vẫn dâng sinh tế và đốt hương trên các nơi cao.
vi.B: Tuy nhiên, các nơi cao không bị dẹp bỏ; dân chúng vẫn dâng sinh tế và đốt hương trên các nơi cao.
vi.R: Nhưng các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao không bị dẹp bỏ. Dân chúng vẫn dâng sinh tế và đốt hương tại các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao.

ko.L: 다만 산당들은 없어지지 않았다. 백성은 여전히 산당들에서 제사를 드리고 분향하고 있었다.
ko.B: 그러나 산당들은 없어지지 않아서, 백성은 여전히 산당에서 제사를 드리고 분향했다.
ko.R: 그러나 산꼭대기 제단들은 없어지지 않았다. 백성은 여전히 산꼭대기 제단에서 제사를 드리고 분향했다.

pt.L: Somente os altos não foram removidos; o povo ainda sacrificava e queimava incenso nos altos.
pt.B: Contudo, os altos não foram removidos; o povo continuava oferecendo sacrifícios e queimando incenso nos altos.
pt.R: Mas os santuários no alto dos morros não foram removidos. O povo continuava oferecendo sacrifícios e queimando incenso nesses santuários.

decisions.choice: verse numbers: Hebrew 22:44-54 is 22:43-53 in many Bibles
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. Many Bibles print this verse as the second half of verse 43, and so number the rest of the chapter one lower: Hebrew 22:45-54 is 22:44-53 there. (A smaller difference comes at verse 21.) The words are the same; only the numbers differ.

decisions.choice: the high places: local places of worship
decisions.reason: High places were local shrines, often on hills, with an altar. Even when they were used to worship Yahweh, sacrifice there went against the law's demand to worship at the one place Yahweh chose (Deuteronomy 12:13-14). Asa did not remove them either (15:14).

decisions.choice: making smoke: burning offerings, or burning incense
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something go up in smoke. It can refer to burning incense or to burning parts of an offering. With "sacrificing" it describes the regular worship at the shrines.

decisions.choice: hilltop shrines
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced say "high places"; Readable says "hilltop shrines", as these books do throughout.

decisions.choice: "los lugares altos no fueron quitados; el pueblo todavía ofrecía sacrificios y quemaba incienso en los lugares altos"
decisions.reason: The high-places formula as the Kings and Chronicles note sets for Spanish, with each level's term for the high places.

decisions.choice: mahali pa juu hapakuondolewa; watu waliendelea kutoa dhabihu na kufukiza uvumba mahali pa juu
decisions.reason: The high-places formula keeps one wording through these books, as the terms note sets; Readable says "patakatifu pa kilimani".

decisions.choice: "산당들은 없어지지 않아서 백성은 여전히 산당에서 제사를 드리고 분향했다"
decisions.reason: The terms note's formula for the high places, held for the kings of Judah through Kings and Chronicles.

source.text: וַיַּשְׁלֵ֥ם יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט עִם־מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And made peace Jehoshaphat with [the] king of Israel.

en.L: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
en.B: Jehoshaphat also made peace with the king of Israel.
en.R: Jehoshaphat also made peace with the king of Israel.

es.L: E hizo paz Josafat con el rey de Israel.
es.B: Josafat también hizo la paz con el rey de Israel.
es.R: Josafat también hizo la paz con el rey de Israel.

fr.L: Et Josaphat fit la paix avec le roi d’Israël.
fr.B: Josaphat fit aussi la paix avec le roi d’Israël.
fr.R: Josaphat a aussi fait la paix avec le roi d’Israël.

sw.L: Yehoshafati akafanya amani na mfalme wa Israeli.
sw.B: Yehoshafati alifanya amani pia na mfalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Yehoshafati alifanya amani pia na mfalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát làm hòa với vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Giô-sa-phát cũng giảng hòa với vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Giô-sa-phát cũng làm hòa với vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 여호사밧이 이스라엘 왕과 화친했다.
ko.B: 여호사밧은 이스라엘 왕과도 화친했다.
ko.R: 여호사밧은 이스라엘 왕과도 평화롭게 지냈다.

pt.L: E Josafá fez paz com o rei de Israel.
pt.B: Josafá também fez as pazes com o rei de Israel.
pt.R: Josafá também fez as pazes com o rei de Israel.

decisions.choice: made peace with the king of Israel: ended the long war between the kingdoms
decisions.reason: Judah and Israel had been at war since the kingdom divided (14:30; 15:6, 16). Jehoshaphat ended it and allied himself with the house of Ahab, as this chapter's campaign shows. His son Jehoram married Ahab's daughter (2 Kings 8:18).

decisions.choice: also
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "also" to link this note to the summary of the reign.

source.text: וְיֶ֨תֶר דִּבְרֵ֧י יְהוֹשָׁפָ֛ט וּגְבוּרָת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר נִלְחָ֑ם הֲלֹֽא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Jehoshaphat and his might which he did and what he waged war, are not they written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of the kings of Judah?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he made war, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, the might he showed and how he waged war, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
en.R: Everything else Jehoshaphat did is written in the history of the kings of Judah. It tells about his great deeds and the wars he fought.

es.L: Y el resto de los hechos de Josafat, y su poder que mostró, y cómo hizo la guerra, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Judá?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Josafat, el poder que mostró y cómo hizo la guerra, están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Judá.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Josafat está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Judá. Allí se habla de sus grandes hazañas y de las guerras que hizo.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes de Josaphat, et la vaillance qu’il a montrée, et comment il a fait la guerre, n’est-ce pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes de Josaphat, la vaillance qu’il a montrée et les guerres qu’il a menées, est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda.
fr.R: Tout ce que Josaphat a fait d’autre a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda. On y parle de ses exploits et des guerres qu’il a faites.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Yehoshafati, na nguvu zake alizozionyesha, na jinsi alivyopigana vita, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Yuda?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Yehoshafati, nguvu alizozionyesha na jinsi alivyopigana vita, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Yuda.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyofanya Yehoshafati yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Yuda. Inaeleza habari za matendo yake makuu na vita alivyopigana.

vi.L: Các việc khác của Giô-sa-phát, sự dũng mãnh ông đã tỏ ra và thể nào ông đã chinh chiến, chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Giu-đa sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của Giô-sa-phát, sự dũng mãnh vua đã tỏ ra và các cuộc chiến vua đã đánh, đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Giu-đa.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác Giô-sa-phát đã làm đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Giu-đa. Sách ấy kể về những việc lớn lao của vua và các cuộc chiến vua đã đánh.

ko.L: 그리고 여호사밧의 나머지 일들과 그가 보인 그의 용맹과 그가 싸운 일은 유다 왕들의 날들의 일들을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?
ko.B: 여호사밧의 나머지 행적과 그가 보인 업적과 그가 치른 전쟁은 유다 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 여호사밧이 한 다른 모든 일은 유다 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다. 그 책에는 그가 이룬 큰일들과 그가 치른 전쟁 이야기도 있다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Josafá, e o poder que ele mostrou, e como guerreou, não estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Judá?
pt.B: Os demais atos de Josafá, o poder que mostrou e as guerras que fez estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Judá.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Josafá fez está escrito na história dos reis de Judá. Ela conta sobre os seus grandes feitos e as guerras que ele lutou.

decisions.choice: his might and how he made war: his military strength and campaigns
decisions.reason: "Might" is a king's strength and deeds of power, especially in war (16:5). Chronicles tells of Jehoshaphat's armies and his wars (2 Chronicles 17:12-19; 20:1-30).

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah: a royal record of Judah now lost
decisions.reason: As at 14:29 and 15:7, the writer sends readers to a fuller record of Judah's kings.

decisions.choice: the source formula
decisions.reason: As in verse 39, with Judah; Balanced and Readable state as a fact what the Hebrew asks as a question.

source.text: וְיֶ֨תֶר֙ הַקָּדֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁאַ֔ר בִּימֵ֖י אָסָ֣א אָבִ֑יו בִּעֵ֖ר מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of the male cult prostitute[s] who remained in [the] days of Asa his father he purged from the land.

en.L: And the remnant of the male cult prostitutes who remained in the days of Asa his father, he purged from the land.
en.B: He also drove out of the land the rest of the male shrine prostitutes who were left from the days of his father Asa.
en.R: He also got rid of the rest of the men who served as prostitutes at the shrines. Some of them had stayed in the land even after his father Asa's time.

es.L: Y el resto de los prostitutos de culto que habían quedado en los días de Asá su padre, los barrió de la tierra.
es.B: También expulsó del país al resto de los prostitutos de los santuarios que habían quedado desde los días de su padre Asá.
es.R: También se deshizo del resto de los hombres que servían como prostitutos en los santuarios. Algunos de ellos habían quedado en el país aun después del tiempo de su padre Asá.

fr.L: Et le reste des prostitués sacrés qui étaient restés aux jours d’Asa son père, il les fit disparaître du pays.
fr.B: Il chassa aussi du pays le reste des hommes qui se prostituaient dans les sanctuaires et qui étaient restés depuis le temps de son père Asa.
fr.R: Il s’est aussi débarrassé du reste des hommes qui servaient de prostitués dans les sanctuaires. Certains étaient restés dans le pays même après l’époque de son père Asa.

sw.L: Na mabaki ya makahaba wa kiume wa ibada waliobaki katika siku za Asa baba yake, akawaondoa kabisa katika nchi.
sw.B: Tena akawafukuza nchini makahaba wa kiume wa mahali pa ibada waliokuwa wamebaki tangu siku za Asa baba yake.
sw.R: Pia akawaondoa nchini wanaume waliobaki waliofanya ukahaba katika mahali pa ibada. Baadhi yao walikuwa wamebaki nchini hata baada ya wakati wa Asa baba yake.

vi.L: Số nam kỹ nơi miếu thờ còn sót lại từ thời A-sa cha ông, ông đã quét sạch khỏi xứ.
vi.B: Vua cũng đuổi ra khỏi xứ số nam kỹ nơi miếu thờ còn sót lại từ thời A-sa cha mình.
vi.R: Vua cũng dẹp bỏ số đàn ông còn lại làm nghề mại dâm tại các nơi thờ thần. Một số người ấy vẫn còn ở trong xứ từ thời A-sa cha vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 아버지 아사의 시대에 남아 있던 신전 남창들의 나머지를 그가 그 땅에서 없애 버렸다.
ko.B: 그는 또 그의 아버지 아사의 시대에 남아 있던 신전 남창들을 그 땅에서 모두 쫓아냈다.
ko.R: 그는 또 신전에서 몸을 파는 남자들 가운데 남아 있던 자들을 그 땅에서 모두 없앴다. 그들 가운데 몇몇은 그의 아버지 아사의 시대가 지난 뒤에도 그 땅에 남아 있었다.

pt.L: E o restante dos prostitutos cultuais que tinham restado nos dias de Asa, o seu pai, ele os eliminou da terra.
pt.B: Ele também expulsou da terra o restante dos prostitutos cultuais que tinham ficado desde os dias do seu pai Asa.
pt.R: Ele também se livrou do resto dos homens que serviam como prostitutos nos santuários. Alguns deles tinham ficado na terra mesmo depois do tempo do seu pai Asa.

decisions.choice: the male shrine prostitutes: men who served at the shrines of other gods
decisions.reason: As at 14:24 and 15:12, the word means "consecrated ones" and names men attached to the shrines, whom the law forbids (Deuteronomy 23:18). Most understand them as men who offered sex as part of the worship there; the evidence for the sexual sense is not certain. Asa had driven them out (15:12), but some remained; Jehoshaphat finished the work.

decisions.choice: purged: removed completely
decisions.reason: The verb means to burn or sweep away, and is used of removing evil from the land (Deuteronomy 13:6).

decisions.choice: the men who served as prostitutes at the shrines
decisions.reason: Readable explains the term with a short description, as at 15:12 (m1).

decisions.choice: prostitutos cultuais (L, B); homens que serviam como prostitutos nos santuários (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 14:24; 15:12): the men attached to the shrines (m1) are "prostitutos cultuais" at Literal and Balanced, the term Portuguese uses for prostitution as part of a cult; Readable explains it, as the English does.

source.text: וּמֶ֥לֶךְ אֵ֛ין בֶּאֱד֖וֹם נִצָּ֥ב מֶֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And king there was not in Edom; a deputy [was] king.

en.L: And [there was] no king in Edom; a deputy [was] king.
en.B: There was then no king in Edom; a deputy ruled as king.
en.R: At that time Edom had no king of its own. A governor ruled the country.

es.L: Y no [había] rey en Edom; un delegado [era] rey.
es.B: No había entonces rey en Edom; gobernaba como rey un delegado.
es.R: En ese tiempo Edom no tenía rey propio. Un gobernador dirigía el país.

fr.L: Et [il n’y avait] pas de roi en Édom ; un gouverneur [était] roi.
fr.B: Il n’y avait pas alors de roi en Édom ; un gouverneur exerçait la royauté.
fr.R: À cette époque, Édom n’avait pas de roi à lui. C’était un gouverneur qui dirigeait le pays.

sw.L: Wala hapakuwa na mfalme katika Edomu; naibu [alikuwa] mfalme.
sw.B: Wakati huo hapakuwa na mfalme katika Edomu; naibu alitawala kama mfalme.
sw.R: Wakati huo Edomu haikuwa na mfalme wake. Gavana aliitawala nchi hiyo.

vi.L: Lúc ấy Ê-đôm không có vua; một quan tổng trấn [làm] vua.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Ê-đôm không có vua; một quan tổng trấn cai trị như vua.
vi.R: Lúc ấy Ê-đôm không có vua riêng. Một quan tổng trấn cai trị xứ ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 에돔에는 왕이 없었고, 대리자가 왕이었다.
ko.B: 그때 에돔에는 왕이 없었고, 대리인이 왕 노릇을 했다.
ko.R: 그때 에돔에는 자기 나라 왕이 없었다. 유다 왕이 세운 총독이 그 나라를 다스렸다.

pt.L: E não [havia] rei em Edom; um governador [era] rei.
pt.B: Naquele tempo não havia rei em Edom; um governador governava como rei.
pt.R: Naquele tempo Edom não tinha rei próprio. Um governador governava o país.

decisions.choice: no king in Edom: Edom was under Judah's control
decisions.reason: Edom lay south of the Dead Sea. A deputy, probably appointed by Judah, ruled in place of a king. This explains how Jehoshaphat could build ships at Ezion-geber, on the Red Sea coast in Edom's territory (verse 49; 9:26). Later Edom had its own king again (2 Kings 3:9; 8:20).

decisions.choice: deputy: an appointed officer
decisions.reason: The word is used for officers appointed over districts (4:5, 7). The short clause "a deputy king" may also mean "the deputy was king" or "a deputy acted as king".

decisions.choice: A governor ruled the country.
decisions.reason: Readable says "governor" for the appointed deputy (m2).

source.text: יְהוֹשָׁפָ֡ט עָשָׂה֩ אֳנִיּ֨וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֜ישׁ לָלֶ֧כֶת אוֹפִ֛ירָה לַזָּהָ֖ב וְלֹ֣א הָלָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ אֳנִיּ֖וֹת בְּעֶצְי֥וֹן גָּֽבֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for the gold, and not it went, for were broken [the] ships at Ezion-geber.

en.L: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but it did not go, for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.
en.B: Jehoshaphat built ships of Tarshish to sail to Ophir for gold, but they never sailed, because the ships were wrecked at Ezion-geber.
en.R: Jehoshaphat built large trading ships to sail to Ophir and bring back gold. But they never sailed, because the ships were wrecked at Ezion-geber.

es.L: Josafat hizo naves de Tarsis para ir a Ofir por oro, pero no fueron, porque las naves se rompieron en Ezión-geber.
es.B: Josafat construyó naves de Tarsis para navegar a Ofir en busca de oro, pero nunca zarparon, porque las naves naufragaron en Ezión-geber.
es.R: Josafat construyó grandes barcos mercantes para navegar a Ofir y traer oro. Pero nunca zarparon, porque los barcos naufragaron en Ezión-geber.

fr.L: Josaphat fit des navires de Tarsis pour aller à Ophir chercher de l’or, mais on n’y alla pas, car les navires se brisèrent à Etsion-Guéber.
fr.B: Josaphat construisit des navires de Tarsis pour aller chercher de l’or à Ophir, mais ils ne partirent jamais, car les navires firent naufrage à Etsion-Guéber.
fr.R: Josaphat a construit de grands navires de commerce pour aller à Ophir et en rapporter de l’or. Mais ils ne sont jamais partis, parce qu’ils ont fait naufrage à Etsion-Guéber.

sw.L: Yehoshafati akatengeneza merikebu za Tarshishi ili ziende Ofiri kwa ajili ya dhahabu, lakini hazikwenda, kwa maana merikebu zilivunjika huko Esion-geberi.
sw.B: Yehoshafati alijenga merikebu za Tarshishi ili zisafiri mpaka Ofiri kuleta dhahabu, lakini hazikusafiri kamwe, kwa sababu merikebu hizo zilivunjika huko Esion-geberi.
sw.R: Yehoshafati alijenga merikebu kubwa za biashara ili zisafiri mpaka Ofiri kuleta dhahabu. Lakini hazikusafiri kamwe, kwa sababu merikebu hizo zilivunjika huko Esion-geberi.

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát đóng tàu Ta-rê-si để đi Ô-phia lấy vàng, nhưng tàu không đi được, vì các tàu bị vỡ tại Ê-xi-ôn Ghê-be.
vi.B: Giô-sa-phát đóng các tàu Ta-rê-si để đi Ô-phia lấy vàng, nhưng tàu không bao giờ ra khơi được, vì các tàu bị đắm tại Ê-xi-ôn Ghê-be.
vi.R: Giô-sa-phát đóng những chiếc tàu buôn lớn để đi Ô-phia chở vàng về. Nhưng tàu không bao giờ ra khơi được, vì chúng bị đắm tại Ê-xi-ôn Ghê-be.

ko.L: 여호사밧이 금을 [가져오려고] 오빌로 가게 하려고 다시스 배들을 만들었으나, 그것이 가지 못했다. 배들이 에시온게벨에서 부서졌기 때문이다.
ko.B: 여호사밧은 오빌에서 금을 실어 오려고 다시스 배들을 만들었으나, 그 배들은 떠나지 못했다. 에시온게벨에서 배들이 부서졌기 때문이다.
ko.R: 여호사밧은 오빌로 가서 금을 실어 오려고 큰 무역선들을 만들었다. 그러나 그 배들은 떠나지 못했다. 에시온게벨에서 배들이 부서졌기 때문이다.

pt.L: Josafá fez navios de Társis para ir a Ofir buscar ouro, mas não foi, porque os navios se despedaçaram em Eziom-Geber.
pt.B: Josafá construiu navios de Társis para navegar até Ofir em busca de ouro, mas eles nunca partiram, porque os navios naufragaram em Eziom-Geber.
pt.R: Josafá construiu grandes navios mercantes para navegar até Ofir e trazer ouro. Mas eles nunca partiram, porque os navios se despedaçaram em Eziom-Geber.

decisions.choice: made: the reading of the Hebrew tradition
alternatives: Jehoshaphat had ten ships of Tarshish
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text is written with consonants that would mean "ten", but the traditional reading, marked in the margin of the Hebrew text, is "made". This translation follows the traditional reading; with the written form the clause would say that Jehoshaphat had ten ships of Tarshish.

decisions.choice: ships of Tarshish: large ocean-going trading ships
decisions.reason: Tarshish was a distant port, probably in the far west of the Mediterranean. "Ships of Tarshish" came to mean large seagoing ships of the kind used on long trade voyages, whatever their route (10:22). These were built on the Red Sea.

decisions.choice: Ophir: a land famous for its gold
decisions.reason: Solomon's fleet sailed from Ezion-geber to Ophir and brought back gold (9:26-28; 10:11). Where Ophir was is not known; Arabia, East Africa and India have all been suggested.

decisions.choice: the ships were wrecked: told also in 2 Chronicles 20:35-37
decisions.reason: Chronicles says that Jehoshaphat built these ships in partnership with Ahaziah king of Israel, and that the prophet Eliezer foretold they would be wrecked because of that alliance. Kings says that Jehoshaphat refused Ahaziah's offer of sailors (verse 50); the two accounts may describe different stages of the venture.

decisions.choice: large trading ships
decisions.reason: Readable says what "ships of Tarshish" were (m2) instead of the name.

decisions.choice: "naves de Tarsis" (L, B); "grandes barcos mercantes" (R); "Ofir", "Ezión-geber"
decisions.reason: Tarsis and Ofir as the terms table sets; Readable explains the ships, as the English does. Ezión-geber is the usual Spanish form.

decisions.choice: "Etsion-Guéber"
decisions.reason: The French spelling with ts and gu, as Tsiqlag and Guibbethôn.

decisions.choice: merikebu za Tarshishi
decisions.reason: "Ships of Tarshish" is kept as a name at Literal and Balanced ("merikebu", large sea-going ships); Readable says they were large trading ships, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: names: "Ta-rê-si", "Ô-phia", "Ê-xi-ôn Ghê-be"
decisions.reason: Tarshish and Ophir as the terms note; Ezion-geber in the usual Protestant form. Readable says "tàu buôn lớn", as the English says "large trading ships".

decisions.choice: "다시스 배" (L, B), "큰 무역선" (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "ships of Tarshish" as a kind of large trading ship, not their destination; Readable says so.

decisions.choice: navios de Társis (L, B); grandes navios mercantes (R); Ofir; Eziom-Geber
decisions.reason: As 10:22 in Portuguese: "navios de Társis" at Literal and Balanced and "grandes navios mercantes" at Readable for the large seagoing ships (m2); "Ofir" as Genesis 10:29 and "Eziom-Geber" as Numbers 33:35 in Portuguese.

source.text: אָ֠ז אָמַ֞ר אֲחַזְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־אַחְאָב֙ אֶל־יְה֣וֹשָׁפָ֔ט יֵלְכ֧וּ עֲבָדַ֛י עִם־עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ בָּאֳנִיּ֑וֹת וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה יְהוֹשָׁפָֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: Then said Ahaziah son of Ahab to Jehoshaphat, let go my servants with your servants in the ships; and not was willing Jehoshaphat.

en.L: Then Ahaziah son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my servants go with your servants in the ships." But Jehoshaphat was not willing.
en.B: Then Ahaziah son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my men sail with your men in the ships." But Jehoshaphat refused.
en.R: Then Ahaziah son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my sailors go with yours on the ships." But Jehoshaphat would not agree.

es.L: Entonces Ocozías hijo de Acab dijo a Josafat: «Que vayan mis siervos con tus siervos en las naves». Pero Josafat no quiso.
es.B: Entonces Ocozías hijo de Acab le dijo a Josafat: «Deja que mis hombres naveguen con los tuyos en las naves». Pero Josafat no quiso.
es.R: Entonces Ocozías hijo de Acab le dijo a Josafat: «Deja que mis marineros vayan con los tuyos en los barcos». Pero Josafat no aceptó.

fr.L: Alors Achazia fils d’Achab dit à Josaphat : « Que mes serviteurs aillent avec tes serviteurs sur les navires. » Mais Josaphat ne voulut pas.
fr.B: Alors Achazia, fils d’Achab, dit à Josaphat : « Que mes hommes partent avec tes hommes sur les navires. » Mais Josaphat refusa.
fr.R: Ensuite Achazia, fils d’Achab, a dit à Josaphat : « Laisse mes marins partir avec les tiens sur les navires. » Mais Josaphat n’a pas voulu.

sw.L: Ndipo Ahazia mwana wa Ahabu akamwambia Yehoshafati, "Watumishi wangu na waende pamoja na watumishi wako katika merikebu." Lakini Yehoshafati hakukubali.
sw.B: Ndipo Ahazia mwana wa Ahabu akamwambia Yehoshafati, "Watu wangu na wasafiri pamoja na watu wako katika merikebu." Lakini Yehoshafati akakataa.
sw.R: Ndipo Ahazia mwana wa Ahabu akamwambia Yehoshafati, "Mabaharia wangu na waende pamoja na wako katika merikebu." Lakini Yehoshafati hakukubali.

vi.L: Bấy giờ A-cha-xia con trai A-háp nói với Giô-sa-phát: "Xin cho các đầy tớ tôi đi tàu với các đầy tớ vua." Nhưng Giô-sa-phát không bằng lòng.
vi.B: Bấy giờ A-cha-xia con trai A-háp nói với Giô-sa-phát: "Xin cho người của tôi đi tàu với người của vua." Nhưng Giô-sa-phát từ chối.
vi.R: Bấy giờ A-cha-xia con trai A-háp nói với Giô-sa-phát: "Xin cho các thủy thủ của tôi đi chung tàu với thủy thủ của vua." Nhưng Giô-sa-phát không đồng ý.

ko.L: 그때 아합의 아들 아하시야가 여호사밧에게 말했다. "내 신하들이 당신의 신하들과 함께 배를 타고 가게 하시오." 그러나 여호사밧은 원하지 않았다.
ko.B: 그때 아합의 아들 아하시야가 여호사밧에게 말했다. "내 사람들이 당신의 사람들과 함께 배를 타고 가게 해 주시오." 그러나 여호사밧은 거절했다.
ko.R: 그때 아합의 아들 아하시야가 여호사밧에게 말했다. "내 뱃사람들이 당신의 뱃사람들과 함께 배를 타고 가게 해 주시오." 그러나 여호사밧은 허락하지 않았다.

pt.L: Então Acazias, filho de Acabe, disse a Josafá: "Que os meus servos vão com os seus servos nos navios." Mas Josafá não quis.
pt.B: Então Acazias, filho de Acabe, disse a Josafá: "Deixe os meus homens navegarem com os seus homens nos navios." Mas Josafá recusou.
pt.R: Então Acazias, filho de Acabe, disse a Josafá: "Deixe os meus marinheiros irem com os seus nos navios." Mas Josafá não concordou.

decisions.choice: my servants with your servants: the kings' men, as crews
decisions.reason: "Servants" here are the men in each king's service who would sail the ships. Ahaziah offers a partnership in the trading venture.

decisions.choice: then: after the ships were wrecked, or while they were being built
decisions.reason: "Then" ties the offer to the shipbuilding, but does not make clear whether it came before or after the wreck. Jehoshaphat's refusal may reflect the warning in 2 Chronicles 20:37.

decisions.choice: men / sailors
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "servants"; Balanced says "men" and Readable "sailors" for what they would be doing (m1).

source.text: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֤ב יְהֽוֹשָׁפָט֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו וַיִּקָּבֵר֙ עִם־אֲבֹתָ֔יו בְּעִ֖יר דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֑יו וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ יְהוֹרָ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Jehoshaphat with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in [the] city of David his father, and reigned Jehoram his son in his place.

en.L: And Jehoshaphat lay down with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the City of David his father, and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Then Jehoshaphat rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David his ancestor. His son Jehoram became king in his place.
en.R: Then Jehoshaphat died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. His son Jehoram became king after him.

es.L: Y durmió Josafat con sus padres y fue sepultado con sus padres en la ciudad de David su padre, y reinó en su lugar Jehoram su hijo.
es.B: Luego Josafat descansó con sus antepasados y fue sepultado con ellos en la ciudad de su antepasado David. Su hijo Jehoram reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Luego Josafat murió y fue sepultado con sus antepasados en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Jehoram lo sucedió como rey.

fr.L: Et Josaphat se coucha avec ses pères et fut enterré avec ses pères dans la cité de David son père, et Yehoram son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Puis Josaphat reposa avec ses ancêtres, et il fut enterré avec eux dans la cité de David son ancêtre. Et Yehoram son fils régna à sa place.
fr.R: Ensuite Josaphat est mort et il a été enterré avec ses ancêtres dans la cité de David. Son fils Yehoram est devenu roi à sa place.

sw.L: Yehoshafati akalala pamoja na baba zake, akazikwa pamoja na baba zake katika mji wa Daudi baba yake, na Yehoramu mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Kisha Yehoshafati akapumzika pamoja na babu zake, akazikwa pamoja nao katika mji wa Daudi babu yake. Na mwanawe Yehoramu akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Kisha Yehoshafati akafa, akazikwa pamoja na babu zake katika mji wa Daudi. Na mwanawe Yehoramu akawa mfalme mahali pake.

vi.L: Giô-sa-phát nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình và được chôn với tổ phụ mình trong thành Đa-vít, tổ phụ ông; Giê-hô-ram con trai ông trị vì thay ông.
vi.B: Giô-sa-phát an giấc cùng tổ tiên và được chôn với tổ tiên trong thành Đa-vít, tổ tiên vua. Giê-hô-ram con trai vua lên kế vị.
vi.R: Giô-sa-phát qua đời và được chôn với tổ tiên trong thành Đa-vít. Giê-hô-ram con trai vua lên kế vị.

ko.L: 그리고 여호사밧이 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 그의 아버지 다윗의 성에 그의 조상들과 함께 묻혔다. 그리고 그의 아들 여호람이 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 여호사밧은 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 그의 조상 다윗의 성에 조상들과 함께 묻혔다. 그의 아들 여호람이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 여호사밧은 죽었고, 다윗 성에 조상들과 함께 묻혔다. 그의 아들 여호람이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E Josafá descansou com os seus pais e foi sepultado com os seus pais na Cidade de Davi, o seu pai; e Jorão, o seu filho, reinou no seu lugar.
pt.B: Então Josafá descansou com os seus antepassados e foi sepultado com eles na Cidade de Davi, o seu antepassado. O seu filho Jorão se tornou rei no seu lugar.
pt.R: Então Josafá morreu e foi descansar com os seus antepassados. Ele foi sepultado com os seus antepassados na Cidade de Davi. O seu filho Jorão se tornou rei depois dele.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The death formula of Kings, as in verse 40.

decisions.choice: David his father: his ancestor David
decisions.reason: "Father" here means forefather, as often in Kings (15:3, 11, 24).

decisions.choice: Jehoram: Jehoshaphat's son, king of Judah
decisions.reason: His reign is told in 2 Kings 8:16-24. A king of Israel of the same name, also called Joram, was Ahab's son (2 Kings 3:1).

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died
decisions.reason: The death formula is worded the same way at each level throughout Kings; Readable adds "was buried with his ancestors" where the Hebrew names the burial.

decisions.choice: his ancestor (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "ancestor" for "father" here (m2), as these books do; Readable leaves it out after "the City of David", as at 15:24.

decisions.choice: "Jehoram"
decisions.reason: Kings spells this king's name two ways; Spanish keeps the form each verse uses, as the terms table sets (Jehoram / Joram).

decisions.choice: "Yehoram"
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps the two spellings the Hebrew uses: Yehoram where the verse has the long form, Joram for the short form.

decisions.choice: "Giê-hô-ram"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew spells this king's name Jehoram here, so the terms note's "Giê-hô-ram" is used; "Giô-ram" is kept for the verses that spell it Joram.

decisions.choice: descansou com os seus pais ... foi sepultado na Cidade de Davi; Jorão
decisions.reason: The death and burial formula as set for the whole book at 2:10. "Jorão" as set for Kings, the form Brazilian readers know, for both the king of Judah and Ahab's son (m3).

source.text: אֲחַזְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־אַחְאָ֗ב מָלַ֤ךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן בִּשְׁנַת֙ שְׁבַ֣ע עֶשְׂרֵ֔ה לִיהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁנָתָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Ahaziah son of Ahab became king over Israel in Samaria in [the] year seventeen of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.

en.L: Ahaziah son of Ahab reigned over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.
en.B: In the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, Ahaziah son of Ahab became king over Israel in Samaria, and he reigned over Israel two years.
en.R: Ahaziah son of Ahab became king over Israel in Samaria. It was the seventeenth year that Jehoshaphat had been king of Judah. Ahaziah ruled over Israel for two years.

es.L: Ocozías hijo de Acab comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en Samaria en el año diecisiete de Josafat rey de Judá, y reinó sobre Israel dos años.
es.B: En el año diecisiete de Josafat rey de Judá, Ocozías hijo de Acab comenzó a reinar sobre Israel en Samaria, y reinó sobre Israel dos años.
es.R: Ocozías hijo de Acab llegó a ser rey de Israel en Samaria. Era el año diecisiete del reinado de Josafat en Judá. Ocozías gobernó a Israel durante dos años.

fr.L: Achazia fils d’Achab régna sur Israël à Samarie en la dix-septième année de Josaphat, roi de Juda, et il régna sur Israël deux ans.
fr.B: La dix-septième année du règne de Josaphat, roi de Juda, Achazia, fils d’Achab, devint roi d’Israël à Samarie ; il régna deux ans sur Israël.
fr.R: Achazia, fils d’Achab, est devenu roi d’Israël à Samarie. C’était la dix-septième année du règne de Josaphat sur Juda. Achazia a régné sur Israël pendant deux ans.

sw.L: Ahazia mwana wa Ahabu akatawala juu ya Israeli huko Samaria katika mwaka wa kumi na saba wa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, naye akatawala juu ya Israeli miaka miwili.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa kumi na saba wa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, Ahazia mwana wa Ahabu alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli huko Samaria, akatawala juu ya Israeli miaka miwili.
sw.R: Ahazia mwana wa Ahabu alianza kutawala juu ya Israeli huko Samaria. Ulikuwa mwaka wa kumi na saba wa utawala wa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda. Ahazia alitawala Israeli kwa miaka miwili.

vi.L: A-cha-xia con trai A-háp trị vì trên Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri vào năm thứ mười bảy đời Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa, và ông trị vì trên Y-sơ-ra-ên hai năm.
vi.B: Năm thứ mười bảy đời Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa, A-cha-xia con trai A-háp lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri và trị vì Y-sơ-ra-ên hai năm.
vi.R: A-cha-xia con trai A-háp lên làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên tại Sa-ma-ri. Lúc ấy là năm thứ mười bảy Giô-sa-phát làm vua Giu-đa. A-cha-xia cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên hai năm.

ko.L: 유다 왕 여호사밧 제17년에 아합의 아들 아하시야가 사마리아에서 이스라엘 위에 왕이 되어, 이스라엘을 2년 동안 다스렸다.
ko.B: 유다 왕 여호사밧이 다스린 지 17년째 되는 해에 아합의 아들 아하시야가 사마리아에서 이스라엘의 왕이 되어 2년 동안 이스라엘을 다스렸다.
ko.R: 아합의 아들 아하시야가 사마리아에서 이스라엘의 왕이 되었다. 그때는 여호사밧이 유다의 왕이 된 지 17년째 되는 해였다. 아하시야는 2년 동안 이스라엘을 다스렸다.

pt.L: Acazias, filho de Acabe, começou a reinar sobre Israel em Samaria no décimo sétimo ano de Josafá, rei de Judá, e reinou sobre Israel dois anos.
pt.B: No décimo sétimo ano de Josafá, rei de Judá, Acazias, filho de Acabe, começou a reinar sobre Israel em Samaria, e reinou sobre Israel dois anos.
pt.R: Acazias, filho de Acabe, se tornou rei de Israel em Samaria. Era o décimo sétimo ano do reinado de Josafá em Judá. Acazias governou Israel durante dois anos.

decisions.choice: the reign of Ahaziah: the account continues in 2 Kings 1
decisions.reason: Ahaziah's reign is introduced here and told in 2 Kings 1. Kings was first one book; the division into 1 and 2 Kings falls in the middle of his reign.

decisions.choice: two years: counted as parts of years
decisions.reason: Kings counts part of a year at either end of a reign as a year, so a reign of "two years" may have lasted little more than one (compare 2 Kings 3:1).

decisions.choice: the date first / two sentences
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the date first, as in the accession formula throughout Kings; Readable splits it into short sentences.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ בְּדֶ֤רֶךְ אָבִיו֙ וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ אִמּ֔וֹ וּבְדֶ֨רֶךְ֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־נְבָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶחֱטִ֖יא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, and walked in [the] way of his father and in [the] way of his mother and in [the] way of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who made Israel sin.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and walked in the way of his father and in the way of his mother and in the way of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who made Israel sin.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He followed the ways of his father and his mother, and the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who led Israel into sin.
